Discover the biblical principles that reveal whether a prophet’s message, character, predictions, and influence align with God’s Word. Learn why discernment is essential and how believers can recognize true prophetic ministry while avoiding deception with greater confidence.

programme.desc: The Exodus stands as the most powerful Old Testament display of God's redeeming love—a breathtaking rescue from bondage, filled with miracles and majesty. Yet as glorious as it was, it pointed forward to an even greater deliverance: the cross of Christ. Like Israel in Egypt, we face a hopeless captivity—one we cannot escape on our own. But God stepped in. The same God who split the sea broke the chains of sin through Calvary. Exodus 12 to 15 captures divine power at its peak, but even that pales next to what Jesus accomplished. Our ultimate deliverance was won by His blood, not ours.

programme.desc: Pentecost was more than a miraculous display of speaking in tongues—it was heaven’s powerful declaration that Jesus Christ was alive, exalted, and reigning at the Father’s right hand! In this 3ABN production, Pastor Louis Torres explores the true significance of the Holy Spirit’s outpouring through Acts 2, Joel’s prophecy, and Peter’s sermon. Just as Jacob knew his son Joseph was alive when he saw the wagons Joseph sent, the disciples received the gift of the Holy Spirit as evidence of Christ’s heavenly enthronement. programme.desc: In this episode, Noah travels to one of the few active volcanoes in the contiguous United States to find out why it’s called, “God’s gift to creationists.” Through cataclysmic events back in the 1980s, similar geologic features worldwide can now be explained by the Flood using Mount St. Helens as a scale model. Noah explores each of these features at the mountain, including a huge lava cave and lava cast forests. The features found here can help us understand catastrophic processes that were thought by secular scientists to take millions of years taking only hours or days.

programme.title: El panel de Escuela Sabática de 3ABN
programme.desc: Descubre por qué comprender correctamente la profecía bíblica es esencial para la fe en Jesucristo. programme.title: Salvación en Señales y Símbolos
programme.desc: El programa “Salvación en Señales y Símbolos” tiene como propósito educar al interesado en entender el Apocalipsis. Romper cualquier duda o barreras que mantenga a lector alejado, intimidado, o tenga cualquier predisposición en contra de las enseñanzas en el Apocalipsis. La visión de las 7 Trompetas han tenido variadas interpretaciones pero este estudio cuidadoso nos lleva a la realidad considerando la interpretación más razonable de las representaciones de esta escena de juicios de parte de Dios. Vemos que nos lleva al Santuario por los muebles allí mencionados para poder entender. Las trompetas suenan por la razón de que en capítulos anteriores los santos clamaban por justicia por lo tanto son la contestación de Dios interviniendo. Tenga su Biblia en mano y estudiemos juntos el libro misterioso y descubramos su importancia.

programme.title: El panel de Escuela Sabática de 3ABN
programme.sub-title: Poniendo a prueba a los profetas
programme.desc: ¿Cómo podemos saber si alguien que afirma tener el don de profecía realmente está hablando en nombre de Dios? Esta lección explora las pruebas bíblicas de un verdadero profeta, comenzando con el consejo de 1 Juan 4:1 de “probar los espíritus”. Así como un diamante es examinado para comprobar su autenticidad, las afirmaciones proféticas deben ser cuidadosamente probadas por medio de las Escrituras. Descubre los principios bíblicos que revelan si el mensaje, el carácter, las predicciones y la influencia de un profeta están de acuerdo con la Palabra de Dios. Aprende por qué el discernimiento es esencial y cómo los creyentes pueden reconocer el verdadero ministerio profético y evitar el engaño con mayor confianza.\.

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy En Vivo
programme.sub-title: El sábado como un don amoroso de Dios
programme.desc: En esta transmisión especial de dos horas, el pastor John Dinzey, gerente general de 3ABN, y el pastor Eduardo Mack profundizan en el estudio bíblico del sábado, destacándolo no solo como un día de reposo, sino como un regalo divino destinado a restaurar la vida espiritual, emocional y relacional del creyente. A lo largo del programa, ambos pastores presentan el fundamento bí blico del sábado desde la creación hasta el ministerio de Jesús, subrayando su carácter santificado por Dios y su propósito como un espacio sagrado para reconectar con Él. También exploran su relevancia para la vida actual, mostrando cómo la observancia del sá bado fortalece la fe, la identidad espiritual y la relación con el Creador. El objetivo central del programa es invitar al espectador a comprender el sábado como un don amoroso de Dios, diseñado para renovar el corazón y enriquecer la experiencia cristiana hoy. Para una variedad de programas de estudios bíblicos, baje la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscríbase al canal 3ABN Latino YouTube. Envie sus preguntas a Latino@3abn.tv Programa EVH250007.

programme.title: Melodías de Victoria
programme.sub-title: MelodíAs De Victoria Con Ysis EspañA
programme.desc: En este episodio de Melodías de Victoria, el presentador Pedro Carriles recibe a la talentosa Ysis España, una artista cuyas canciones han tocado los corazones de miles de personas alrededor del mundo. Con más de 25 años de trayectoria, Ysis ha sido testigo del poder transformador de la música y el llamado divino en su vida. A lo largo de esta entrevista, descubriremos más sobre su ministerio musical, las lecciones aprendidas en su caminar con Dios, y las inspiradoras anécdotas de cómo Él ha guiado cada paso de su carrera. ¡ No te pierdas esta conversación única y llena de inspiración! Este y otros programas enriquecedores son parte de la programación que ofrece 3ABN Latino. programme.title: Salvación en Señales y Símbolos
programme.desc: El programa “Salvación en Señales y Símbolos” tiene como propósito educar al interesado en entender el Apocalipsis. Romper cualquier duda o barreras que mantenga a lector alejado, intimidado, o tenga cualquier predisposición en contra de las enseñanzas en el Apocalipsis. La visión de las 7 Trompetas han tenido variadas interpretaciones pero este estudio cuidadoso nos lleva a la realidad considerando la interpretación más razonable de las representaciones de esta escena de juicios de parte de Dios. Vemos que nos lleva al Santuario por los muebles allí mencionados para poder entender. Las trompetas suenan por la razón de que en capítulos anteriores los santos clamaban por justicia por lo tanto son la contestación de Dios interviniendo. Tenga su Biblia en mano y estudiemos juntos el libro misterioso y descubramos su importancia.

programme.title: 3ABN Hoy En Vivo
programme.sub-title: El sábado como un don amoroso de Dios
programme.desc: En esta transmisión especial de dos horas, el pastor John Dinzey, gerente general de 3ABN, y el pastor Eduardo Mack profundizan en el estudio bíblico del sábado, destacándolo no solo como un día de reposo, sino como un regalo divino destinado a restaurar la vida espiritual, emocional y relacional del creyente. A lo largo del programa, ambos pastores presentan el fundamento bí blico del sábado desde la creación hasta el ministerio de Jesús, subrayando su carácter santificado por Dios y su propósito como un espacio sagrado para reconectar con Él. También exploran su relevancia para la vida actual, mostrando cómo la observancia del sá bado fortalece la fe, la identidad espiritual y la relación con el Creador. El objetivo central del programa es invitar al espectador a comprender el sábado como un don amoroso de Dios, diseñado para renovar el corazón y enriquecer la experiencia cristiana hoy. Para una variedad de programas de estudios bíblicos, baje la aplicación 3ABN+ y suscríbase al canal 3ABN Latino YouTube. Envie sus preguntas a Latino@3abn.tv Programa EVH250007.

programme.title: El panel de Escuela Sabática de 3ABN
programme.sub-title: Poniendo a prueba a los profetas
programme.desc: ¿Cómo podemos saber si alguien que afirma tener el don de profecía realmente está hablando en nombre de Dios? Esta lección explora las pruebas bíblicas de un verdadero profeta, comenzando con el consejo de 1 Juan 4:1 de “probar los espíritus”. Así como un diamante es examinado para comprobar su autenticidad, las afirmaciones proféticas deben ser cuidadosamente probadas por medio de las Escrituras. Descubre los principios bíblicos que revelan si el mensaje, el carácter, las predicciones y la influencia de un profeta están de acuerdo con la Palabra de Dios. Aprende por qué el discernimiento es esencial y cómo los creyentes pueden reconocer el verdadero ministerio profético y evitar el engaño con mayor confianza.\.

The grandson of legendary underwater explorer Jacques Cousteau, Philippe hosts and serves as executive producer of this half-hour earth science series that examines the planet. He visits diamond and gold mines to see how gems and metals are formed, travels to active volcanoes to observe what happens inside the Earth's burning core, and checks out weather stations in mountainous areas to get an idea of how weather phenomena form in the atmosphere.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space
programme.desc: Americans have been fascinated by the cosmos for decades and rely on NASA to explore celestial bodies seen in the night sky to get a better idea of what is out there. In this series, former NASA employee Emily Calandrelli visits some of the agency's facilities, private companies and universities to speak with people knowledgeable about the topic to help "show off the coolest aspects of the space industry," to use her words. Technology, a potential manned mission to Mars and planetary tourism are some themes.

programme.title: Nature Knows Best
programme.desc: Marine biologist Danni Washington hosts this series that explains how nature has helped to inspire technology that people use on a daily basis. Some of the nature-inspired innovations include airplanes inspired by birds and helicopters that were influenced by dragonflies. The show also introduces viewers to people involved in creating innovations that are based on animals, including biologists who study the behavior of ants, architects designing "living buildings" and roboticists who are making their designs bigger and stronger based on animals.

programme.title: Animal Rescue
programme.desc: Just about everybody likes animals and doesn't like to see animals who are sick, injured or abused. So "Animal Rescue," a weekly series -- aimed at children and families -- that showcases spectacular rescues of animals, should be very popular. Because people don't like to see an animal's situation get so bad that it requires rescue, the program tries to avoid those situations by instructing children on the proper care of animals, as well as giving safety tips on caring for all types of creatures.

"Hiring America" tries to make it a little easier by showcasing companies that have jobs available for current and former members of the armed forces. programme.title: Small Town Big Deal
programme.desc: To put a spin on a popular saying about Las Vegas, what happens in a small town stays in a small town. That's because small cities and towns across America often get lost in the mainstream media that focuses on major metropolitan areas like New York and Los Angeles. "Small Town Big Deal" tries to change that by telling the stories of innovation, tradition and success that are happening in rural places. Episodes cover small-town residents having an impact on others through their actions and notable businesses, including the Frankenmuth, Mich., retail store that is considered the world's largest Christmas store.

programme.title: Street Magic
programme.desc: Troy Von Scheibner first became interested in magic at the age of 12, practiced the art through various odd jobs throughout childhood and college, and now is one of the most popular magicians in England. This reality series shows what happens when the performer hits the streets of London to showcase his close-up magic and stunts for unsuspecting locals and tourists. Von Scheibner takes advantage of his surroundings by drawing inspiration from the city's landmarks while integrating them into some of his illusions, such as teleporting across Tower Bridge. Some of Troy's tricks are more restrained, though, like when he uses his talents to help passengers get off of a bus.

programme.title: The Buddy Holly Story

Later they play a major booking at the Apollo Theater, scheduled there under the mistaken assumption that they're a black band. Holly's career eventually goes solo -- until the tragic day the music dies.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: The masked swordsman (Antonio Banderas) and his wife (Catherine Zeta-Jones) fight a European count (Rufus Sewell) plotting to block California's statehood.","large":"A secret society, the Knights of Aragon, seeks to keep the United States from achieving manifest destiny -- and only the legendary Zorro (Antonio Banderas) can stop them. Unfortunately, Zorro, also known as Don Alejandro de la Vega, has problems of his own: His wife, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is divorcing him for spending too much time pursuing heroics and not enough being a father to their young son. programme.title: Brian's Song

Piccolo helps Sayers overcome an injury, and Sayers later gives Piccolo much needed support when he's diagnosed with terminal cancer.

programme.title: Crossroads
programme.desc: A guitar student (Ralph Macchio) tours the Deep South with an old blues man (Joe Seneca), chasing a lost song written by Robert Johnson.

programme.title: The Baby-Sitters Club
programme.desc: Seven girls balance the growing pains of adolescence with the demands of operating a daycare camp for children.","large":"Kristy Thomas and her six best friends struggle to make their successful business -- the Baby-Sitters Club -- into a full-fledged summer day camp. Meanwhile, each club member faces her own personal challenges, including divorced parents, a discouraging diabetes diagnosis and an innocent crush on an older boy.

programme.title: Annie

programme.title: Blue Streak

programme.title: Breakout
programme.desc: A woman (Jill Ireland) hires a bush pilot (Charles Bronson) to free her husband (Robert Duvall), framed for a murder, from a Mexican prison.

programme.title: Cheers
programme.desc: Laid-back Sam Malone, a former relief pitcher for the Boston Red Sox, owns and runs Cheers, a cozy bar in Boston. He hires smart, uptight -- and jilted -- Diane Chambers as a server, out of sympathy, but their attraction causes constant bickering. Wacky characters fill the bar: sarcastic waitress Carla, beer-loving accountant Norm, know-it-all postman Cliff. When Diane leaves Boston much later, Sam sells the bar, buys a boat and sails the world, but his boat sinks, so he returns. New, ambitious manager Rebecca Howe hires him back, but they love to hate each other too.

programme.title: Family Ties
programme.desc: Steven and Elyse Keaton, once 1960s radicals, now find themselves in Reagan-era American trying to raise a traditional suburban family. Son Alex P. Keaton is an ambitious young Republican, and his sister Mallory is a shallow victim of the corporate culture, obsessed with music, clothes and boys. Their only normal kid is young Jennifer, a bit of a tomboy. In later seasons, the Keatons add a fourth child, Andrew. Most of the comedy arose from the conflict between the liberal parents and the conservative children.

programme.title: The Better Way
programme.desc: Thinking about getting married but feeling discouraged by the current state of society? This series presented by Pastor Octavian Poenaru may offer some reassurance that with God's leading, healthy relationships can last and even be restored. Learn the short and long-term negative effects of marital conflicts, the main predisposing factor for conflicts and how to develop a strategy for solving them.

programme.title: Mind Wars - Eric Walsh
programme.desc: In this three-part series, Eric Walsh exposes Satan’s attempts to distract us from the soon return of Jesus Christ through his subtle threats upon our generation. Though especially aimed at young people, this series offers a warning relevant to all ages.

programme.title: Anchor 2024: The Great Prophecies of the Old Testament Part II
programme.sub-title: Notes On Daniel 7: The Beasts, The Little Horn, And The Judgment, Part 1
programme.desc: Anchor is a seminary-level course of study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and provide the theological skills to share with others the reason for the hope that is in them. Will your anchor hold in the coming storm?

programme.title: Equipping The Saints
programme.desc: The church was never intended to be merely a social club for members but a training school for missionaries. This eye-opening series presented by Kameron Devasher will reveal God's original design for His people to be personally active in giving the gospel to the world, winning souls for His kingdom, and hastening the return of Jesus.

programme.title: The 24 Elders
programme.desc: There has been much discussion in the Seventh-day Adventist church about the identity of the 24 elders. Some believe that they represent those who resurrected with Jesus. Others believe that they are the highest of angels. Who is this select group and what is their function in the heavenly courts? What lessons do they teach us regarding God's mode of operating the universe? These and other questions are clearly answered in this ground-breaking series.

programme.title: Misinterpreted Texts on the State of the Dead
programme.desc: We live in a world captivated by the supernatural. Spiritualism has deeply influenced our media and entertainment. But what does the Bible actually teach about the state of the dead? Does the soul depart from the body at death? Are the righteous in heaven praising God? Are the wicked currently suffering in hell? In this enlightening series, Pastor Stephen Bohr explores these vital questions and more, offering clear, biblical answers about death and the afterlife.

programme.title: Silencing Satan
programme.desc: Humanity has witnessed Satan’s relentless attempts to bring about destruction. In the face of such pervasive evil, sincere questions naturally arise - questions that may cause people to doubt God’s power, love, or even His very existence. This series confronts those challenging questions head-on, offering faith-affirming answers straight from God’s Word. Through hope and truth Satan can be silenced.

programme.title: The Best of I'd Like to Know
programme.sub-title: Am I Violating The Sabbath with Exercise?
programme.desc: The Best of I'd Like to Know revisits some of the series’ most compelling questions about the Bible, faith, and Christian life. Through Scripture-based answers and thoughtful discussion, these selected episodes invite you to discover timeless biblical truths, and deepen your understanding of God’s Word.

programme.sub-title: Revelation's Supreme Court in the Most Holy Place
programme.desc: Have you found yourself wondering: What is going on in this world? If God is good how can he allow pain and injustice? In the limited understanding and infinite corruption of the world, we do not find answers that satisfy our souls. Only in God's Word and through the messages of Revelation can we find understanding, hope and peace.

programme.title: Come Out of Her My People
programme.desc: Satan has sought to counterfeit God’s intimate gifts with self-centered indulgences, and sadly many have fallen for the deception. One of God’s most intimate gifts, sex, was created to foster deep connection within the covenant of marriage between a man and a woman. So how can we overcome sinful desires that go against His design? Not by our own strength, but by surrendering our thoughts to Jesus and allowing the Holy Spirit to transform our hearts.

This series will provide you with helpful ministry tips and inspiring testimonies of those who have answered the call to outreach ministry. "And the Good News about the Kingdom will be preached throughout the whole world, so that all nations will hear it; and then the end will come.." (Matthew 24:14).

programme.desc: A compelling series about God’s transofrmative power to break the cycle of sin in our lives. With heartfelt insight, Lo-Ammi explains why we struggle and reveals the key to finding the lasting peace we all long for. Through seven transformative steps, you’ll learn how to live as a victorious Christian. The struggle is real but so is the victory through Jesus Christ!

programme.title: Anchor 2018: The End-Time Dimensions of the Parables
programme.desc: Anchor is a seminary-level course study on the fundamentals of Seventh-day Adventist theology, taught by Pastor Stephen Bohr. The mission of ANCHOR is to settle students into the Truth both intellectually and spiritually and to provide the theological skills to share their new found hope and knowledge with others.

programme.title: His Way Is in the Sanctuary
programme.desc: One writer once stated: “The correct understanding of the ministration in the heavenly sanctuary is the foundation of our faith. ” (EV 221). But why is this so? What makes the doctrine of the sanctuary so important?In this series, Pastor Bohr explains how the many doctrines of the Bible, such as the divine/human nature of Christ, the salvation of sinful man, the Sabbath, the ten commandments, the state of the dead, the judgment, tithing, healthful living, the work of angels, and even end-time events, are explained in the sanctuary service. With simplicity and clarity he shows how the sanctuary is the great magnet which draws together all the doctrines of the Bible into a unified system of truth. Definitely a must-see!

programme.title: Being Woman
programme.desc: Being Woman is an empowering educational series that delves into the intricacies of women's health. Whether tackling menstrual irregularities, fertility concerns, hormone imbalance, or just wanting to understand the female anatomy, this series gives viewers a deeper understanding of the body, mind and spirit connection. We hope you find encouragment to embrace every health journey with faith and reverence.

programme.title: Anchor 2017: The Hebrew Religious Calendar
programme.desc: Before Jesus came to this earth, He sat down with His Father and planned the seven successive steps that He would take in the plan of salvation. However, not only did they plan the steps but they also prepared a detailed calendar when those steps would take place. The Hebrew Sanctuary reveals the events of salvation history and the Feast reveal the calendar of those events. This study focuses on the seven Feasts and their relationship to the sanctuary. Included is a study of the season of the Messiah's birth, the three days and three nights and whether Christians are still required to observe the Feasts. Your faith in the God who knows the end from the beginning will be strengthened.

programme.desc: The universe is a big place - is there any evidence out there to prove if it was all formed by a big bang or by a Creator? Dive into topics such as volcanoes, dinosaurs, erosion, botany, cosmology,mountains, the geologic column and so much more! Follow along as we travel around the world looking for clues and evidence about God.

When we honor our bodies by fueling them with the natural God-given foods presented in the Bible, we feel capable to carry out the mission God has for our lives. This series, featuring many educated hosts, presents step-by-step demonstrations for delicious vegetarian/vegan recipes that will help you enjoy your food and live well!

programme.title: God's Principles for Healthy Relationships - Season 2

They address the prevalence of broken families and relationships marred by abusive behaviors, identity crises, lack of leadership, commitment and genuine love. They firmly believe that Happily Ever After is not a myth, but a reality attainable through following God's plan and committing to the necessary effort, with the belief that “In His presence, there is fullness of Joy.” Psalm 16:11. programme.title: Sisters
programme.desc: A recently divorced woman (Amy Poehler) and her hotheaded sister (Tina Fey) throw a party that spirals out of control at their childhood home.","large":"When their parents decide to sell their home, siblings Maura (Amy Poehler) and Kate (Tina Fey) learn that they have one weekend to clean out the junk from their old bedroom. Unhappy with the news, the recently divorced Maura and her hotheaded sister make plans to throw one final bash to recapture their glory days with their former classmates. As the raging party begins to spiral out of control, the gals soon realize that there may not be a house left once the dust settles.

programme.title: Head Over Heels
programme.desc: A New Yorker living with four models falls for a neighbor who may be a murderer.

programme.title: Patch Adams
programme.desc: After struggling with depression, a doctor, once a psychiatric patient, uses humor and unconventional methods in his practice.","large":"After struggling with depression in a mental hospital, Hunter "Patch" Adams decides he wants to become a doctor. He enrolls at Virginia Medical University but is disillusioned by the school's clinical perspective on patient care. With the aid of a wealthy friend, Adams opens his own medical clinic for those without insurance. He forms a deep bond with fellow medical student Carin Fisher before a tragedy causes Adams to re-evaluate his approach.

programme.title: Reality Bites
programme.desc: An aspiring filmmaker (Winona Ryder) follows the paths of her friends after they graduate from college in Texas.","large":"After college, Lelaina (Winona Ryder) films a documentary about herself and friends as they flounder in their attempts to forge relationships and begin careers. Vickie (Janeane Garofalo) works retail, has an endless string of one-night stands and awaits the results of her HIV test. Sammy (Steve Zahn) tries to come out to his parents. Lelaina gets involved with yuppie Michael (Ben Stiller) while maintaining a love-hate relationship with Troy (Ethan Hawke), who's undergoing an existential crisis.

programme.title: The Purge
programme.desc: A wealthy family is held hostage for harboring the target of a murderous syndicate during the Purge, a 12-hour period in which any and all crime is legal.","large":"In an America ravaged by crime and overcrowded prisons, the government sanctions an annual 12-hour period during which all criminal activity -- including murder -- is legal. James Sandin and his family face the ultimate test when an intruder drags the vicious outside world into their home. James, Mary and their two children struggle to survive the night while trying not to turn into monsters like the ones they are striving to avoid.

programme.title: The Purge: Election Year
programme.desc: Former Police Sergeant Barnes becomes head of security for Senator Charlie Roan, a Presidential candidate targeted for death on Purge night due to her vow to eliminate the Purge.","large":"As a young woman, Sen. Charlie Roan survived the annual night of lawlessness that took the lives of her family members. As a presidential candidate, Roan is determined to end the yearly tradition of bloodlust once and for all. When her opponents hatch a deadly scheme, the senator finds herself trapped on the streets of Washington, D.C., just as the latest Purge gets underway. Now, it's up to Leo Barnes, her head of security, to keep her alive during the next 12 hours of mayhem.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: A woman (Kate Hudson) takes a job as a hospice nurse for a couple (Gena Rowlands, John Hurt) who live in a New Orleans house with a troublesome history.","large":"Caroline Ellis (Kate Hudson), a good-natured nurse living in New Orleans, quits her job at a hospice to work for Violet Devereaux (Gena Rowlands), an elderly woman whose husband, Ben (John Hurt), is in poor health following a stroke. When Caroline begins to explore the couple's rundown Bayou mansion, she discovers strange artifacts and learns the house has a mysterious past. As she continues to investigate, she realizes that Violet is keeping a sinister secret about the cause of Ben's illness.

programme.title: The Last House on the Left
programme.desc: After their daughter is assaulted and left for dead, a couple (Tony Goldwyn, Monica Potter) take revenge on the assailants, who have taken shelter at the couple's house.","large":"Mari and her friend look forward to a holiday at the remote Collingwood lake house, but instead an escaped convict (Garret Dillahunt) and his crew kidnap them and later leave them for dead. Mari makes her way back home, where her parents, John (Tony Goldwyn) and Emma (Monica Potter), have unwittingly offered shelter to the thugs. When John and Emma find out what happened to their daughter, they decide to make the strangers rue the day they harmed Mari.

programme.title: Doom
programme.desc: A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge, is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach.","large":"A team of space marines known as the Rapid Response Tactical Squad, led by Sarge (Karl Urban), is sent to a science facility on Mars after somebody reports a security breach. There, they learn that the alert came after a test subject, a mass murderer purposefully injected with alien DNA, broke free and began killing people. Dr. Grimm (Rosamund Pike), who is related to team member Reaper (The Rock), informs them all that the chromosome can mutate humans into monsters -- and is highly infectious.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: Paranoia spreads among a team of Arctic researchers as they battle a deadly alien organism that assumes the shapes of its victims.","large":"After Norwegian researchers discover an alien ship buried in the ice, paleontologist Kate Lloyd (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) joins the team at the isolated Arctic outpost to investigate. She finds an organism that appears to have perished in the crash eons ago but, in fact, is about to awake. Freed from its icy prison, the insidious life-form goes on the attack. Paranoia spreads like wildfire among the crew as they fight to survive against a creature that assumes the shapes of its victims.

programme.title: Snow White and the Huntsman
programme.desc: Sent by an evil queen (Charlize Theron) to capture an escaped princess (Kristen Stewart), a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) instead becomes the young woman's protector and helps her in her quest to regain control of her kingdom.","large":"Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron), who seized control of her kingdom by marrying and killing its rightful ruler, needs the life force of young maidens to maintain her beauty. However, to become truly immortal, Ravenna must consume the heart of her stepdaughter Snow White (Kristen Stewart). Snow escapes, and Ravenna dispatches a huntsman (Chris Hemsworth) to capture her. But Snow, the Huntsman and a rebel army join forces to destroy Ravenna and restore the balance of life and death.

programme.title: The Wolfman
programme.desc: A nobleman (Anthony Hopkins) contends with an ancient curse, scouring his childhood homeland for his missing brother, while a bloodthirsty beast prowls the moors.","large":"Though absent from his ancestral home of Blackmoor for many years, aristocrat Lawrence Talbot returns to find his missing brother at the request of the latter's fiancée, Gwen. He learns that a creature has links to an ancient curse turning people into werewolves when the moon is full. To save the village and protect Gwen, he must slay the bloodthirsty beast, but he contends with a horrifying family legacy.

programme.title: The Mummy Returns
programme.desc: The mummified body of Imhotep is shipped to a museum in London, where he once again wakes and begins his campaign of rage and terror.","large":"Ten years after the events of the first film, Rick and Evelyn O'Connell are settled in 1935 London, where they are raising their son. When a chain of events finds the corpse of Imhotep resurrected, the O'Connells go on a desperate race to save the world from unspeakable evil and to rescue their son before it is too late.

programme.title: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programme.desc: After his son is tricked into awakening a cursed Chinese emperor, Rick O'Connell and his family seek a way to send the megalomaniac and his 10,000 warriors back to their graves.","large":"Cursed by a devious sorceress, China's ruthless Dragon Emperor (Jet Li) and his vast army lie buried in clay for millennia. When young archaeologist Alex O'Connell is tricked into reviving the emperor, he and his famous parents (Brendan Fraser, Maria Bello) must find a way to send the ghoul back to the grave before he can awaken his vast army and take over the world.

programme.title: Hellboy II: The Golden Army
programme.desc: Hellboy and his team face an underworld prince who plans to awaken a lethal army and use it to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred.","large":"Hellboy (Ron Perlman), his pyrokinetic girlfriend, Liz (Selma Blair), and aquatic empath, Abe Sapien (Doug Jones), face their biggest battle when an underworld prince (Luke Goss) plans to reclaim Earth for his magical kindred. Tired of living in the shadow of humans, Prince Nuada tries to awaken an ancient army of killing machines to clear the way for fantasy creatures to roam free. Only Hellboy can stop the dark prince and prevent humanity's annihilation.

programme.title: Drag Me to Hell
programme.desc: Christine Brown has a good job, a great boyfriend, and a bright future. But in three days, she's going to hell.","large":"Christine Brown has a loving boyfriend and a good job at a Los Angeles bank. Her heavenly life becomes hellish when, in an effort to impress her boss, she denies an old woman's request for an extension on her home loan. In retaliation, the crone places a curse on Christine, threatening her soul with eternal damnation. Christine seeks a psychic's help to break the curse, but the price to save her soul may be more than she can pay.

programme.title: Fear
programme.desc: A deranged suitor (Mark Wahlberg) torments family and friends of a teen girl (Reese Witherspoon) with whom he is obsessed.","large":"When 16-year-old Nicole Walker (Reese Witherspoon) meets 23-year-old David McCall (Mark Wahlberg) at a Seattle nightclub, she falls in love. David is exciting and charming, and despite the wide age gap, he wins over Nicole's family -- except for her workaholic father, Steven (William Petersen), who's suspicious of David from the start. His concerns are realized when David turns out to be a violent sociopath who sees Nicole as his possession, and her family home a fortress to be invaded.

programme.title: Carlito's Way
programme.desc: Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld.","large":"A free man after years in prison, Carlito Brigante intends to give up his criminal ways, but it's not long before the ex-con is sucked back into the New York City underworld. Reconnecting with his dancer girlfriend, Gail, Carlito gets entangled in the shady dealings of his friend Dave Kleinfeld, who also serves as his lawyer. When Carlito and Kleinfeld run afoul of shifty gangster Benny Blanco, it sets them on a dangerous path.

programme.title: The Eagle
programme.desc: Accompanied by his slave, a Roman soldier (Channing Tatum) heads to Scotland's Highlands to retrieve the long-lost Ninth Legion's emblem, and in doing so, to restore his father's honor.","large":"Under the command of Flavius Aquila in A.D. 120, Rome's Ninth Legion marches north carrying its revered eagle emblem and vanishing into the mists. Rumors of the legion's golden eagle appearing in a tribal temple reach Marcus Aquila (Channing Tatum), Flavius' son, 20 years later. Accompanied by his slave (Jamie Bell), Marcus makes a dangerous journey to Scotland to retrieve the hallowed eagle and, in doing so, to restore his father's tarnished honor.

programme.title: Death Race: Beyond Anarchy
programme.desc: Black ops specialist Connor Gibson infiltrates a maximum security prison to take down legendary driver Frankenstein in a violent and brutal car race.

programme.title: Assault on Precinct 13
programme.desc: A cop must arm prisoners to help fend off an attack by gunmen who want to kill a gangster locked away in the crumbling station.","large":"While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men.

programme.title: Self/less
programme.desc: A rich cancer patient (Ben Kingsley) undergoes a radical procedure that transfers his consciousness into the body of a healthy young man (Ryan Reynolds), but when he delves into his new body's origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.","large":"Billionaire industrialist Damian Hale (Ben Kingsley) is master of his universe, until he encounters a foe that he can't defeat: cancer. His only hope is a radical medical procedure called "shedding," in which his consciousness is transferred to a healthy body. After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. When he delves into Edward's mysterious origin, he learns that some will kill to keep it secret.

programme.title: The Kingdom
programme.desc: A sympathetic Saudi police captain helps a team of federal agents flush out a terrorist cell in Riyadh.","large":"Charged with the most important assignment of his career, federal agent Ron Fleury has one week to assemble a team, infiltrate and destroy a terrorist cell based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Culture shock and opposition from local law enforcement combine to hinder his progress and that of his elite team, but a sympathetic Saudi police captain becomes an unexpected comrade-in-arms.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: A scam artist (Terrence Howard) introduces a young man (Channing Tatum) to New York's bare-knuckle street-fighting circuit.","large":"Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Jet Li's Fearless
programme.desc: After spending time in a remote village to atone for his past, a martial artist (Jet Li) gets caught in a duel to defend China's honor against his country's enemies.","large":"After a terrible tragedy, a martial artist (Jet Li) retreats to a remote village to gain a new appreciation for the important things in life, but when he returns to the city to reconcile his past with the present, he gets caught up in a duel to the death defending China's honor.

programme.title: Hard Target
programme.desc: Hired to find a missing person in New Orleans, a merchant seaman (Jean-Claude Van Damme) becomes the prey of those (Lance Henriksen, Arnold Vosloo) who hunt men for sport.","large":"Chance Boudreaux (Jean-Claude Van Damme), a sailor skilled in martial arts, is employed to guard Natasha Binder (Yancy Butler) as she tracks down her father, an itinerant Vietnam veteran living in New Orleans named Douglas (Chuck Pfarrer). They soon uncover a sinister group of wealthy men who hunt the homeless for sport, paying them $10,000 if they can survive a crosstown journey. When Chance discovers that Natasha's father was one of their victims, he decides to destroy the evil hunters.

programme.title: Hard Target 2
programme.desc: A retired mixed martial artist (Scott Adkins) is offered one final bout, but he learns he has been tricked into becoming the target of a human hunt when he arrives for the fight.

programme.title: The Quest
programme.desc: Sold into the underworld of gambling and kickboxing, a street criminal (Jean-Claude Van Damme) vies with the world's best fighters in an ancient Tibetan competition.","large":"In the slums of New York City during the 1920s, petty thief Chris Dubois (Jean-Claude Van Damme) finds himself on the run from the police. At the docks, he hides on an outbound freight ship leaving for Asia. Taken in by the mysterious Lord Dobbs (Roger Moore) as the boat docks in Thailand, Dubois is introduced to the underground world of martial arts fighting. His training culminates in a secret battle between the world's greatest fighters that takes place before a select audience in Tibet.

programme.title: Darkman
programme.desc: An acid-scarred scientist (Liam Neeson) uses 99-minute masks to be with his girlfriend (Frances McDormand) and trap gangsters.","large":"When thugs employed by a crime boss lead a vicious assault on Dr. Peyton Wilder, leaving him literally and psychologically scarred, an emergency procedure allows him to survive. Upon his recovery, Wilder can find solace only by returning to his scientific work developing synthetic skin, and seeking revenge against the crime boss. He assumes a phantom avenger persona called Darkman, who, with malleable facial qualities, is able to infiltrate and sow terror in the criminal community.

programme.title: The Thing
programme.desc: An alien that can duplicate other life forms invades a polar research station in this remake of the 1951 classic "The Thing from Another World."","large":"In remote Antarctica, a group of American research scientists are disturbed at their base camp by a helicopter shooting at a sled dog. When they take in the dog, it brutally attacks both human beings and canines in the camp, and they discover that the beast can assume the shape of its victims. A resourceful helicopter pilot and the camp doctor lead the camp crew in a desperate, gory battle against the vicious creature before it picks them all off, one by one.

programme.title: Firestarter
programme.desc: Quasifederal agents hunt a man (David Keith), who can bend minds, and his daughter (Drew Barrymore), who can start fires by staring.","large":"As youths, Andy McGee and his future wife, Vicky, participated in secret experiments, allowing themselves to be subjected to mysterious medical tests. Years later, the couple's daughter, Charlie, begins to exhibit the ability of setting fires solely with her mind. This volatile talent makes the youngster extremely dangerous, and soon she becomes a target for the enigmatic agency known as "The Shop.".

programme.title: Child's Play 2
programme.desc: While Andy's mother is admitted to a psychiatric hospital, the young boy is placed in foster care, and Chucky, determined to claim Andy's soul, is not far behind.","large":"Two years after serial killer Charles Lee Ray (Brad Dourif) inserted his soul into a Chucky doll, a toy company attempts to re-create the doll, bringing Ray back in the process. The possessed doll, intent on claiming a human body, kills his way toward former owner Andy (Alex Vincent), who now lives in a foster home. Andy's foster sister, Kyle (Christine Elise), tries to protect him, but his foster parents believe Andy is just a troubled kid -- and Chucky's murderous path continues.

programme.title: Child's Play 3
programme.desc: Chucky returns for revenge against Andy, the young boy who defeated him, and now a teenager living in a military academy.","large":"It's been years since Chucky, the doll with the soul and the voice (Brad Dourif) of a psychopathic killer, was apparently destroyed in a fire at a doll factory. Now Chucky's manufacturer is remaking the same line of toys with the old, still haunted materials. This resurrects Chucky, who goes after Andy (Justin Whalin), his former owner, who now attends military school. Chucky slashes his way through a string of grotesque murders as Andy tries to stop the homicidal doll and the spirit within it.

programme.title: Bride of Chucky
programme.desc: Animated by a vicious killer's spirit, a battered doll and its mate seek help from neighbors (Katherine Heigl, Nick Stabile) to regain human form.","large":"After being cut apart by the police, killer doll Chucky (Brad Dourif) is resurrected by Tiffany (Jennifer Tilly), an ex-girlfriend of the serial murderer whose soul is inside the toy. Following an argument, Chucky kills Tiffany and transfers her soul into a bride doll. To find the magical amulet that can restore them both to human form, Chucky and Tiffany arrange to be driven to New Jersey by Jesse (Nick Stabile) and Jade (Katherine Heigl), who are unaware that their cargo is alive.

programme.title: Tremors
programme.desc: Four big worms with multiple tongues dig high-speed around people (Kevin Bacon, Fred Ward, Finn Carter) in the middle of nowhere.","large":"Repairmen Val McKee (Kevin Bacon) and Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) are tired of their dull lives in the small desert town of Perfection, Nev. But just as the two try to skip town, they happen upon a series of mysterious deaths and a concerned seismologist (Finn Carter) studying unnatural readings below the ground. With the help of an eccentric couple (Reba McEntire, Michael Gross), the group fights for survival against giant, worm-like monsters hungry for human flesh.

programme.title: Tremors II: Aftershocks
programme.desc: The Mexican government hires two handymen (Fred Ward, Michael Gross) to battle huge man-eating worms plaguing an oil field.","large":"After spending all the reward money from his first encounter with the giant man-eating worms called Graboids, Earl Bassett (Fred Ward) agrees to hunt more of the deadly creatures at a Mexican oil refinery for $50,000 each. Knowing that he cannot face the monsters alone, Earl recruits Burt Gummer (Michael Gross), another veteran of the incident in Nevada, to supply the firepower. There is only one problem: The Graboids have now evolved to attack above ground.

programme.sub-title: Choosing Fuel: Which Barrel Is Right for You?
programme.desc: The guys study the fueling demands, horsepower, and the pros and cons of running different types of fuel.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Water-Meth Injection: Is It Cooler Than the Intercooler??
programme.desc: The guys explore the cooling benefits of water-methanol injection.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The guys test air filter size, along with cold air system configuration.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: Nitrous for Noobs - The 150 Shot Walkthrough
programme.desc: Using a basic 150-horse plate system, the crew demonstrates the basics on installation, safety and tuning for a typical carbureted engine.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: We explore the differences between single and split-duration camshafts.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: Testing intake upgrades for a street car swap; pitting the factory manifold against a worked-up aftermarket piece.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: The Piston Pin Offset Flip -- Is It a Flop?
programme.desc: The guys perform what may be the first ever back-to-back comparison of factory-oriented pistons against reverse-oriented pistons.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.desc: The General Mayhem 440 is strapped on the dyno and decisions on which intake and headers to run, as well as how to squeeze out more than the 707 Hellcat horsepower, are made.

programme.title: Engine Masters
programme.sub-title: A Crash Course in Valve Float
programme.desc: Some know valve float as the evil that lurks beyond the redline, the dreaded robber of horsepower and destroyer of valves; taking a look at the valve float.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: The team tears into a 1962 Chevy truck; Joe Martin plans to create a radical custom lowrider that scrapes the ground; improvements include a new air-ride suspension, tray, front end and paint job.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe has big plans for a 1964 Lincoln Continental, but a faulty steering column and a close call in the shop threaten to turn the flip into a never-ending money pit.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe and the gang turn a 1953 Ford Ranch Wagon into a mean beach cruiser; an accident occurs in the shop; the race is on to repaint a client's custom-built bike.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe and the team work on a 1973 Pontiac Firebird that was damaged by fire; a waterlogged engine puts the brakes on the build.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: The team tackles a custom Softail from the ground up; Shag and Amanda discover a 1947 International milk truck in need of repair; a customer brings in a 1955 Chevy race car.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe believes that wide wheels and a killer paint job will attract customers to a 1964 Cadillac Coupe DeVille convertible, but hidden rust on the vehicle threatens to spoil his planned improvements.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Martin Bros. Customs prepares to transform a 1970 Chevy C10 into an autocross hot rod; Shag and Amanda desperately search for a sturdy cab for the build.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: A 1935 Chevrolet Master rolls into the shop; made famous by the gangsters of its time, the vehicle features a distinctive grill, wood interior and "suicide doors.".

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: A weather-beaten 1959 Metro rolls into the shop for a makeover from the inside out; the vehicle's new owner gets a surprise twist.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: The crew works on a rare, American-made classic -- a 1962 Chevy Corvette; the customer wants his muscle car restored to original factory condition, which won't be cheap.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: A client loves her trucks, particularly the 1950 Chevy, but with a list of customizations the size of Texas, this build might test Joe's mechanical genius.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Known for its sizzling performance and smooth body style, the 1969 Pontiac GTO is one of the fastest cars of its time; Joe gives it his signature twist with body modifications and a new power train.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Mandi stumbles across a 1971 Volkswagen Karmann Ghia and challenges her husband, Joe, to make the car cool.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe can hardly believe his luck when he finds a pristine '62 Impala owned by a customer who wants to cut it up and strip it back; everything comes to a halt when money troubles threaten to leave this job in limbo.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: Joe gets his hands on a '67 Chevy Nova and the crew has some modifications in store; as all great work comes at a cost, Shag and Amanda need to find a buyer with deep pockets.

programme.title: Iron Resurrection
programme.desc: A 1959 Chevrolet Impala arrives at the shop looking more like a parts donor than a serious project; unable to turn down a car with such classic style, Joe comes up with a plan.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: A client wants Bill to set the bar for custom SUVs with a 2018 Yukon Denali; the guys get busy with chassis, body mods, interior and twin turbos; Ekstensive goes full gangster with a 1948 Mercury, remaking a legendary car from the inside out.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Ekstensive's built a lot of trucks, but never a Ford Bronco until now; Bill and the guys transform a rusted '68 Bronco roadster into a high-powered off-roading truck with a supercharged engine, handmade dash, roll cage, and waterproof interior.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: The 2018 Camaro ZL1 is already a high performance sports car, but the owner wants Bill to improve his even more; the guys are happy to oblige, starting with a handmade aluminum chassis and interior; a new client wants his Sierra Denali frame dropped.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the gang are back under the hood of the 2018 Camaro ZL1, rebuilding the engine to add as much power as possible before a visit to the dynamometer; Ekstensive tries to turn a patinated 1949 GMC pickup sleeper truck into a keeper truck.

programme.title: Texas Metal
programme.desc: Bill and the team bring a wrecked '70 Suburban hauler back to life as a long bed, four door, crew cab dually with a 5.9 Cummins diesel engine, custom chassis and suspension; a '65 Plymouth Belvedere II gets some extra muscle with a Mopar crate Hemi.

programme.title: Belcanto
programme.desc: Maria e le sue figlie, Antonia e Carolina, lasciano Napoli per sfuggire dal violento marito e inseguire il sogno del canto a Milano. Nel mondo dorato e spietato dell'Opera di metà 800, affrontano inganni, tradimenti e passioni travolgenti.

programme.title: La strada di casa
programme.desc: Fausto non crede che il figlio sia un assassino e si convince che la scomparsa di Irene sia legata a quella di un bambino ospite di una casa famiglia. Fausto scopre un sabotaggio. Gloria teme di essere affetta da Alzheimer.

programme.desc: Quando Enrico viene licenziato a causa dei suoi metodi poco ortodossi, Titti prende le sue difese. Carlo si autoproclama difensore di Persichetti, un compagno di classe affetto dai pidocchi.

programme.desc: For the residents of Grover's Corners, daily life proceeds at a predictable pace. The milkman (Stuart Erwin) arrives like clockwork, the neighbors perpetually gossip about nothing and children contemplate their future. Two of these children, George (William Holden) and Emily (Martha Scott), fall in love as adults and, despite last-minute nerves, get married. As Confederate forces draw nearer, the Birdwells must make some difficult, life-altering decisions.

Ironically, his silence makes him the person Kay turns to the most for help, which in turn helps him.

programme.title: TGV: Der große Check-up
programme.desc: Das Technikzentrum Hellemmes in der Nähe von Lille ist das größte Wartungszentrum der SNCF für den Personenverkehr in Frankreich. Der Standort ist auf Wartung und Modernisierung spezialisiert. Die Sendung wirft einen Blick hinter die Kulissen.

programme.title: Tempo durch Technik
programme.desc: Seit seiner zufälligen Entdeckung im Jahr 1946 hat der Mikrowellenherd den Küchenalltag grundlegend verändert. Die Geschichte beleuchtet die faszinierende Entwicklung dieser Technologie bis hin zu einem der verbreitetsten Haushaltsgeräte.

programme.title: Man vs. Time - Im Wettlauf mit der Zeit
programme.desc: Die Sendung wirft einen Blick auf die Entstehungsgeschichte und den Nutzen des Pappbechers. Zu Beginn wurde der Becher aus gesundheitlichen Gründen konzipiert. In der heutigen Zeit dient er dazu, den Alltag der Menschen zu beschleunigen.

programme.title: Tempo durch Technik
programme.desc: Der Barcode reduzierte Kassenzeiten und trug zu Veränderungen in der globalen Lieferkette bei.

programme.title: Tempo durch Technik
programme.desc: Die Spülmaschine benötigt rund 230 Stunden weniger manuelle Arbeit pro Jahr und verbraucht weniger Wasser und Energie als Handwäsche.

programme.title: Geniale Mega-Maschinen
programme.desc: Die Sendung beschäftigt sich mit kolossalen Maschinen, die ungeahnte Möglichkeiten eröffnen, um die tief in der Erde verbogenen Schätze zu bergen. Sie ermöglichen den Zugang zu Materialien, die die Infrastruktur und Technologien vorantreiben.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Heuschnupfen wird zur Volkskrankheit. Fast zehn Prozent aller Krankschreibungen sind auf die allergische Krankheit zurückzuführen. Dazu hat sich die Pollenflugdauer durch den Klimawandel verlängert. Die Sendung zeigt, was Abhilfe schaffen kann.

programme.title: Viren - Der unsichtbare Feind
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation stellt die Erforschung von Viren im Labor und im Krankenhaus dar.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Diagnose unbekannt - Leben mit einer seltenen Erkrankung
programme.desc: Rund 8.000 seltene Krankheiten existieren weltweit. Doch sie werden nur wenig erforscht. Die möglichen Profite für Pharmaunternehmen sind zu gering. Für die Patienten bedeutet das: mit ihrer Krankheit leben lernen.

programme.title: Besser essen, länger leben?
programme.desc: Eine gesunde Ernährungsweise ist wichtig für die Gesundheit. Ärzte, Köche und Ernährungswissenschaftler zeigen, wie man sich gesünder ernähren kann, indem man frische Zutaten in Mahlzeiten einbaut. Dabei kommt auch der Geschmack nicht zu kurz.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: ADHS bei Erwachsenen - Hummeln im Hirn
programme.desc: ADHS galt lange als Krankheit von Kindern und Jugendlichen. Doch sie kann auch Erwachsene betreffen, wenn sie nicht früh erkannt wird und unbehandelt bleibt. Knapp fünf Prozent der Erwachsenen haben ADHS - und wissen es oft nicht.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Etwa 1,8 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland sind tablettenabhängig, mehr als von Alkohol. Meist wird das Leiden erst spät erkannt. Schnell steigen der Suchtdruck und die Dosis. Wie ergeht es Betroffenen, und welche Wege gibt es aus dem Teufelskreis?

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Kinderkliniken am Limit - Hochleistung trotz Dauerstress
programme.desc: Es herrscht Notstand auf deutschen Kinderstationen. Deutschlandweit fehlt es an Personal, Betten und Medikamente sind auch knapp. Die Leidtragenden sind die Kinder und ihre Eltern. Doch auch die Pflegekräfte und Ärzte geraten täglich an ihre Grenzen.

programme.title: Single-Mann mit Kinderwunsch
programme.desc: Als alleinstehender Mann ein Kind zu adoptieren, ist in Europa so gut wie unmöglich. Den meisten Männern bleibt nur der Weg ins Ausland. Ian konnte durch eine Eizellenspende und eine Leihmutter in den USA Drillinge bekommen, die er allein großzog.

programme.title: Ärzte ohne Grenzen - Dem Leben verschrieben
programme.desc: Das Flüchtlingslager Domiz im kurdischen Nordirak: Jeden Tag kommen hunderte neue Bürgerkriegsflüchtlinge aus Syrien hier an. Über 35.000 Menschen haben in dem Lager in überfüllten Verschlägen und Zelten eine vorübergehende Bleibe gefunden. Nur wenige Hilfsorganisationen sind hier tätig. Es fehlt an allem.

programme.title: Ärzte ohne Grenzen - Dem Leben verschrieben
programme.desc: Seit drei Monaten arbeitet Bernhard als medizinischer Leiter am Projekt. Seine Aufgabe ist, die Bevölkerung der Provinz Boquerón auf Chagas zu testen und bereits infizierte Personen entsprechend zu behandeln, da die vorhandene Medizin veraltet ist.

programme.title: Modern Explorers
programme.desc: Monte Brento befindet sich in den italienischen Alpen und ist ein wunderbarer Ort, um neue Tricks mit dem Wingsuit auszuprobieren, und für einen querschnittgelähmten Freund aus Dubai das perfekte Gebiet, um auch weiterhin abzuspringen.

programme.title: Der XXL-Mähdrescher - Erntefabrik auf Rädern
programme.desc: In Zweibrücken in Rheinland-Pfalz befindet sich eines der größten Mähdrescher-Werke Europas. Die Nutzfahrzeuge werden von dort weltweit ausgeliefert und eingesetzt. Der dort produzierte T670 ist eine komplette Erntefabrik auf Rädern.

programme.title: Held des Ackers - Ein Hightech-Traktor entsteht
programme.desc: Der Axion 960 CEMOS gilt in Fachkreisen als ein Traktor mit besonders nachhaltiger Technologie. Die Maschine benötigt bis zu 20 Prozent weniger Kraftstoff bei einer Leistung von maximal 445 PS. Die Modelle werden in Frankreich gebaut.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Windkraftanlagen erzeugen weltweit inzwischen mehr als 700 Gigawatt Strom, genug, um fast 500 Millionen Haushalte zu versorgen. Eine Schlüsselrolle kommt künftig leistungsstarken Offshore-Windparks wie East Anglia One vor der britischen Küste zu.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft
programme.desc: Die Suche nach einer neuen, vor allem nachhaltigen Energiequelle ist die bislang größte technische Herausforderung. Forscher arbeiten seit Jahren an der Entwicklung eines Fusionsreaktors, der endlos Energie liefern soll, bislang vergebens.

programme.title: Welt der Zukunft

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh Yozura begibt sich diesmal nach Zypern. Von Nikosia aus reist er quer durch das Land zu einem verlassenen Vergnügungspark. Außerdem besucht er ein ehemaliges Asbestbergwerk und ein Schiffswrack, das sich vor der Küste befindet.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Diesmal ist Cody Buffinton gemeinsam mit Lexi Limitless in New Orleans unterwegs. Gemeinsam erkunden die beiden zunächst ein verlassenes Spital in der Stadt in Louisiana. Anschließend trifft Cody noch auf Brutus, einen Riesenalligator.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh ist in der ehemaligen Sowjetrepublik Armenien unterwegs und besucht die Hauptstadt Jerewan. Er hat vor, dort einige der längst verlassenen, aber noch immer faszinierenden Gebäude aus der Zeit der Sowjetbesatzung zu besuchen.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh Yozura kehrt nach Gary im Nordwesten des Bundesstaates Indiana zurück, um sich zu Hause einmal genauer umzusehen. Er und seine Freunde erkunden gemeinsam ein ehemaliges Bankgebäude, das Auditorium und den Bahnhof Union Train Station.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Cody besucht Zagreb, die im Nordwesten gelegene Hauptstadt des Landes Kroatien. Dort feuert er eine Kanone aus dem alten Turm ab und erkundet ein nie fertig gestelltes Universitätskrankenhaus. Außerdem besucht er eine politische Schule.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Die Städteentdecker Josh und Cody besuchen Barentsburg, eine russische Polarstation und Bergarbeitersiedlung am Isfjord auf Spitzbergen. Sie bereisen einige der schönsten Städte der Welt und entdecken dabei viele spektakuläre Orte.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh begibt sich auf eine weitere Reise. Diesmal macht er sich von Tirana, der Hauptstadt des alten Sowjet-Satelliten Albanien, auf den Weg, um Bunker und ein verstecktes Krankenhaus zu besichtigen. Er taucht in einer Piratenhöhle.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Cody Buffinton erlebt ein weiteres spannendes Abenteuer, als er in Lüderitz, Namibia, unterwegs ist. Er begibt sich in Gebiete abseits der ausgetretenen Pfade, durchquert die Wüste und reist weiter in die Geisterstadt Pomona.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Josh und Lexi Limitless erkunden gemeinsam die überfüllten Straßen von Tokio, der bevölkerungsreichsten Metropole Japans. Die beiden besuchen ein völlig verrücktes Monster-Café und ein verlassenes Liebeshotel in der faszinierenden Stadt.

programme.title: Epic Exploring: Going Local
programme.desc: Diesmal führt die Reise nach Nikko in Japan. Die Stadt liegt etwa 140 Kilometer nördlich von Tokio. Dort trifft Cody auf Sherman Mak. Gemeinsam erkunden die beiden einen verlassenen Onsen und einen Vergnügungspark, das Western Village.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Die Kämpfer des Tierreichs wissen sich zu verteidigen. Alligatorenschildkröten nutzen ihren Panzer mit hornartigen Schuppen und scharfen Stacheln als Schutzschild. Die Stacheln des Stachelschweins verfügen über kleine Widerhaken.

programme.title: Wildes Brasilien
programme.desc: Die weiten Grasebenen im Herzen Brasiliens, die zu den am wenigsten bekannten Regionen des Landes zählen, werden porträtiert. Diese Graswelt voller Termitenbauten ist zehnmal so groß wie die Serengeti Afrikas, doch Tierherden sucht man vergeblich. Mähnenwölfe, Ameisenbären, Prärieeulen und Kapuzineraffen führen hier ein eher verstecktes Leben, geprägt von Hitze, Gewitterstürmen und Steppenfeuern.

programme.title: Wildes Brasilien
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation führt in die Wasserwelt des Pantanal. Jaguare, Fischotter und Wasserschweine sind im Labyrinth aus Flüssen, Seen und Inseln im Vorteil, bis die jährlichen Regenfälle einsetzen. Dann wandelt sich das Pantanal in eine ausgedehnte Sumpflandschaft, in der Kaimane, Fische und Anacondas in ihrem Element sind. Auch Vögel, wie der Jabiru und der Hyazinth-Ara, haben im Pantanal eine sichere Heimat gefunden.

programme.title: Re:
programme.desc: Heuschnupfen wird zur Volkskrankheit. Fast zehn Prozent aller Krankschreibungen sind auf die allergische Krankheit zurückzuführen. Dazu hat sich die Pollenflugdauer durch den Klimawandel verlängert. Die Sendung zeigt, was Abhilfe schaffen kann.

programme.title: Viren - Der unsichtbare Feind
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation stellt die Erforschung von Viren im Labor und im Krankenhaus dar.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: Diagnose unbekannt - Leben mit einer seltenen Erkrankung
programme.desc: Rund 8.000 seltene Krankheiten existieren weltweit. Doch sie werden nur wenig erforscht. Die möglichen Profite für Pharmaunternehmen sind zu gering. Für die Patienten bedeutet das: mit ihrer Krankheit leben lernen.

programme.title: Besser essen, länger leben?
programme.desc: Eine gesunde Ernährungsweise ist wichtig für die Gesundheit. Ärzte, Köche und Ernährungswissenschaftler zeigen, wie man sich gesünder ernähren kann, indem man frische Zutaten in Mahlzeiten einbaut. Dabei kommt auch der Geschmack nicht zu kurz.

programme.title: Re:
programme.sub-title: ADHS bei Erwachsenen - Hummeln im Hirn
programme.desc: ADHS galt lange als Krankheit von Kindern und Jugendlichen. Doch sie kann auch Erwachsene betreffen, wenn sie nicht früh erkannt wird und unbehandelt bleibt. Knapp fünf Prozent der Erwachsenen haben ADHS - und wissen es oft nicht.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Tiere passen sich extremen Bedingungen an: Frösche nutzen Frostschutzmittel in der Leber, Eisbären verlangsamen den Stoffwechsel, Pompeji-Würmer schützen sich mit einem Chitinpanzer und Japanmakaken wärmen sich in heißen Quellen.

programme.title: Tierische Superhelden
programme.desc: Die Kämpfer des Tierreichs wissen sich zu verteidigen. Alligatorenschildkröten nutzen ihren Panzer mit hornartigen Schuppen und scharfen Stacheln als Schutzschild. Die Stacheln des Stachelschweins verfügen über kleine Widerhaken.

programme.title: Wildes Brasilien
programme.desc: Die weiten Grasebenen im Herzen Brasiliens, die zu den am wenigsten bekannten Regionen des Landes zählen, werden porträtiert. Diese Graswelt voller Termitenbauten ist zehnmal so groß wie die Serengeti Afrikas, doch Tierherden sucht man vergeblich. Mähnenwölfe, Ameisenbären, Prärieeulen und Kapuzineraffen führen hier ein eher verstecktes Leben, geprägt von Hitze, Gewitterstürmen und Steppenfeuern.

programme.title: Wildes Brasilien
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation führt in die Wasserwelt des Pantanal. Jaguare, Fischotter und Wasserschweine sind im Labyrinth aus Flüssen, Seen und Inseln im Vorteil, bis die jährlichen Regenfälle einsetzen. Dann wandelt sich das Pantanal in eine ausgedehnte Sumpflandschaft, in der Kaimane, Fische und Anacondas in ihrem Element sind. Auch Vögel, wie der Jabiru und der Hyazinth-Ara, haben im Pantanal eine sichere Heimat gefunden.

programme.title: Leuchtfeuer des Lebens
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation widmet sich Lebewesen, die ihr eigenes Licht produzieren können. Das ist nicht nur nützlich, sondern auch lebenswichtig für die Wesen, die in der Dunkelheit überleben müssen. Anzutreffen sind sie beispielsweise nachts, in dunklen Höhlen oder der Tiefsee. Dazu gehören Würmer, Pilze und Bakterien. Mithilfe ihres Leuchtens können sie sowohl Beute anlocken als auch Feinde abschrecken oder einen Partner zur Fortpflanzung finden.

programme.title: Die Sicht der Spinne
programme.desc: Derek Muller enthüllt die Geheimnisse des faszinierenden Sehvermögens von Spinnen.

programme.title: Welt der Insekten
programme.desc: Auf der Erde gibt es zwischen fünf und zehn Millionen verschiedene Arten und bis zu zehn Quintillionen Insekten. Das macht die Erde zweifelsfrei zu einem Insektenplaneten. Viele dieser winzigen Tierchen haben außergewöhnliche Fähigkeiten.

programme.title: Welt der Insekten
programme.desc: Die Sendung befasst sich mit der Paarung und Fortpflanzung von den Insekten der Erde. Sie sind kleine Lebewesen in einer großen Welt und haben Tricks entwickelt, um sich gegenseitig für die Paarungsrituale zu finden und Nachwuchs zu zeugen.

programme.title: Welt der Insekten
programme.desc: Soziale Insekten wie Ameisen, Bienen, Wespen und Termiten breiten sich sehr erfolgreich aus. Laut Schätzungen wiegen die Ameisen der Welt so viel wie alle Menschen zusammen. Und das Gewicht der Termiten entspricht dem aller Landwirbeltiere.

programme.title: Bright Now!
programme.desc: Ein alarmierender Rückgang der Insektenpopulationen könnte alles Leben auf der Erde vernichten. In dieser Episode wird untersucht, was dieses Phänomen verursachen könnte und ob es etwas gibt, was getan werden kann, um es zu stoppen.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: In befreundeten und feindlichen Gewässern verfügen die am feinsten abgestimmten Kriegsschiffe und U-Boote der Militärgeschichte über Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Tarnfähigkeit, Geschwindigkeit, Tragfähigkeit und Angriffsstärke.

programme.title: Titans of Defense
programme.desc: Ob sie wichtige Versorgungsgüter zum Schlachtfeld fliegen, über Kampfeinsätzen schweben oder internationale Missionen unter schwierigsten Bedingungen durchführen: Militärhubschrauber sind für ihre Aufgaben bestens gerüstet.

programme.title: Die Bundespolizei
programme.sub-title: Zu Wasser, zu Lande und in der Luft
programme.desc: In der Sendung wird die deutsche Bundespolizei bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit begleitet.

programme.title: Die Bundespolizei
programme.desc: In der Sendung wird die deutsche Bundespolizei bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit begleitet.

programme.title: Die Prärie - Rückkehr der Wildnis
programme.desc: Im Herzen Nordamerikas liegen die Northern Great Plains. Die Grasweisen scheinen oft endlos, doch die Wildnis ist stark bedroht. Wo einst Herden von Bisons und Gabelböcken grasten, erstreckt sich über weite Gebiete Agrar- oder Farmland.

programme.title: Wenn die Welt innehält - Natur im Aufschwung
programme.desc: Als die Welt während der Pandemie stillstand, erholten sich Ökosysteme und Tierarten kehrten zurück.

programme.title: Welt ohne Wasser
programme.desc: Die Wasserknappheit ist in vielen Regionen der Erde wie etwa in Kalifornien zu einem großen Problem geworden. Experten suchen dringend nach Lösungen, die Entdeckung eines riesigen Grundwasserleiters vor der amerikanischen Küste weckt Hoffnungen.

programme.title: Asien in der Klimakrise
programme.desc: Die Dokumentation zeigt die Regionen, die infolge des Klimawandels von Überflutung bedroht sein werden. Betroffen sind bis zum Jahr 2100 über eine Milliarde Menschen in niedrig gelegenen Küstengebieten, davon 70 Prozent alleine in Südostasien.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory in Singapur wollen herausfinden, was Küstenstädte zum Sinken bringt. Außerdem sollen Gelder aufgebracht werden, um die Region zukünftig für die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels zu rüsten.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory in Singapur forschen nach den Folgen des Klimawandels für Küsteninfrastrukturen inklusive Häfen und den Handel. Außerdem wollen sie wissen, wie gut die betroffenen Gebiete vorbereitet sind.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Wissenschaftler des Earth Observatory of Singapore tauchen ab und erforschen die Auswirkungen des Klimawandels auf den Ozean und sammeln Ideen für künstliche Riffe. Sie entdecken eine Korallenart, die resistent gegen den Klimawandel ist.

programme.title: Asiens Ozeane im Wandel
programme.desc: Die Länder und Inseln in Südostasien erheben sich zu großen Teilen kaum über den Meeresspiegel. Von einem Anstieg des Meeresspiegels im Zuge der Klimaerwärmung sind sie daher existenziell bedroht. Es kommt bereits zunehmend zu Überflutungen.

programme.title: TGV: Der große Check-up
programme.desc: Das Technikzentrum Hellemmes in der Nähe von Lille ist das größte Wartungszentrum der SNCF für den Personenverkehr in Frankreich. Der Standort ist auf Wartung und Modernisierung spezialisiert. Die Sendung wirft einen Blick hinter die Kulissen.

programme.title: Held des Ackers - Ein Hightech-Traktor entsteht
programme.desc: Der Axion 960 CEMOS gilt in Fachkreisen als ein Traktor mit besonders nachhaltiger Technologie. Die Maschine benötigt bis zu 20 Prozent weniger Kraftstoff bei einer Leistung von maximal 445 PS. Die Modelle werden in Frankreich gebaut.

programme.title: The Secrets to Civilization
programme.desc: In the last decade, the search for data about the planet's environmental history has raised questions about how climate change has influenced human civilizations in the past.

programme.desc: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang.

programme.title: Black Pioneer
programme.desc: Green Flake, an enslaved pioneer and member of the Latter-day Saints, embarks on a courageous cross-country journey that becomes integral to the Mormon migration and the settlement of Utah.

programme.title: Boss
programme.desc: Two ex-slave bounty hunters (Fred Williamson, D'Urville Martin) take care of business in a lawless Wild West town.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands (Rod Cameron), a reformed outlaw living in a small Mexican town, learns that his brother has been killed in the Texas Panhandle, and he sets out to investigate. When he arrives, he's confronted by a trio of gunslingers working for Matt Garson (Reed Hadley), a local gambler and saloon owner. He also begins to court June O'Carroll (Anne Gwynne), Garson's secretary. John soon grows to believe Garson is responsible for his brother's death, leading to a final showdown.

programme.title: The Cowboy and the Indians
programme.desc: Rancher Gene Autry tries to aid neighboring Navajos suffering from malnutrition, but he is opposed by a crafty and crooked trading post proprietor.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: Little Big Horn
programme.desc: Captain Phillip Donlin (Lloyd Bridges) and his small troop must rush to reach Little Big Horn in order to warn General Custer of the Sioux attack that awaits him. As they race against time, and Donlin pushes them hard through an arduous and dangerous journey, the Sioux start taking out the soldiers one at a time. Meanwhile, Donlin also clashes with Lt. John Haywood (John Ireland), who Donlin knows is having an affair with his wife, Celie (Marie Windsor).

programme.title: Oklahoma Annie
programme.desc: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day.

programme.title: Prairie Rustlers
programme.desc: In a small town, the sheriff is murdered, and Deputy Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), a diner owner by day, must take over the slain lawman's responsibilities. The leader of the cattle rustlers who killed the sheriff is named Jim (Buster Crabbe), and he bears a striking resemblance to Fuzzy's friend Billy (Buster Crabbe), much to the deputy's confusion. Billy comes to town, and, to help Fuzzy and vanquish the rustlers, he must face Jim, his cousin, who still holds a grudge against him.

programme.title: Boss
programme.desc: Two ex-slave bounty hunters (Fred Williamson, D'Urville Martin) take care of business in a lawless Wild West town.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

Posing as a Native American, Panhandle sets in motion a clever plan aimed at ensnaring the bandits.

It seems that Terry's brother and one of his employees were wounded by gun-toting thugs. Eddie and Soapy realize that they'll need to get to the bottom of things, so they devise a clever plan to lure the bad guys back to the scene.

programme.title: Return of the Lash

But Fuzzy, who is in charge of delivering it, loses the money as well as his memory. Now it's up to Davis to set things right and prevent land baron Jim Kirby (George Chesebro) from getting his hands on the cash.

programme.title: Stage to Mesa City
programme.desc: Valiant U.S. Marshal Cheyenne Davis (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his trusty deputy, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are on their way to aid a stagecoach owner who is mired in financial burdens. But, when they arrive and discover he's been murdered, the loyal pair are asked by Margie (Jennifer Holt), his daughter, to seek out his killers and make them pay for their vile crime. The investigation soon leads them to a sneering lawyer (Marshall Reed), who has a mysterious boss.

programme.title: Blue Steel
programme.desc: Undercover federal marshal John Carruthers (John Wayne) is suspected by the local sheriff, Jake (George Hayes), of stealing the town's payroll, but his suspicions are sidelined when young Betty Mason (Eleanor Hunt) announces that her father, an important businessman, has been murdered. Without him, supplies will not reach town, and homesteaders will starve. When town leader Malgrove (Edward Peil) offers to buy the locals out, John and Jake get suspicious, and uncover a land-grabbing conspiracy.
