programme.title: The Beast With a Million Eyes
programme.desc: An alien lands by spaceship and makes birds, cows and other animals attack a ranch family.

programme.title: Lord of Illusions
programme.desc: Private eye Harry D'Amour travels to Los Angeles and meets with a new client, Dorothea Swann. Swann reveals that she and her husband — famed magician Philip Swann — have been targeted by a religious cult experimenting with reincarnation. After Philip dies on stage in the midst of a dangerous trick, D'Amour must struggle to protect Dorothea from the ruthless cult members and their newly reanimated religious leader, Nix.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Vampires on Bikini Beach
programme.desc: Californians (Jennifer Badham, Todd Kaufman) try to save their beach from a ghoul and his gang.

programme.title: Secret of Deep Harbor
programme.desc: A reporter (Ron Foster) covers the waterfront and catches his girlfriend's (Merry Anders) father (Barry Kelley) smuggling gangsters.

programme.title: Raiders of the Seven Seas
programme.desc: A fierce pirate, Barbarossa (John Payne) captures a Spanish ship with bravado. Discovering the beautiful Contessa Alida (Donna Reed) on board, Barbarossa falls for the elegant aristocrat, but she is to wed the sailor Jose Salcedo (Gerald Mohr). Although Alida is resistant to Barbarossa's charms, she slowly warms up to him, particularly after she discovers that Salcedo isn't the man that she thought he was. Naturally, Barbarossa proceeds to sort things out with a series of sword battles.

programme.title: The Living Ghost
programme.desc: When wealthy banker Walter Craig (Gus Glassmire) disappears, former private eye Nick Trayne (James Dunn) comes out of retirement to find the missing man. As Nick gets to know the contentious Craig family, the rich man reappears, but someone has put him in an unresponsive, zombie-like state. Then a member of the family is found stabbed to death, with Walter standing over him. When Walter attacks Nick, it seems that the catatonic banker is the killer, but Nick thinks there is more to the mystery.

programme.title: Ghost of Dragstrip Hollow
programme.desc: Lois Cavendish (Jody Fair) hangs out at a nearby soda shop with her drag racing club. But when she learns the shop might be closed, she calls her wealthy aunt, Anastasia (Dorothy Neumann), for help. Anastasia offers the club the chance to use her mansion as their headquarters -- but with one strange condition: They have to scare away the ghost that haunts her home. When the club decides to throw an all-night monster mash party at the mansion, it becomes clear that something is amiss.

programme.title: The Angry Red Planet
programme.desc: Chief Warrant Officer Sam Jacobs (Jack Kruschen), Dr. Iris Ryan (Nora Hayden), Professor Theodore Gettell (Les Tremayne) and Col. Tom O'Bannion (Gerald Mohr) are astronauts aboard the spaceship MR-1, the first mission to Mars. Shortly after their rocket reaches the mysterious red planet, the band of brave space explorers discovers monstrous yet highly intelligent alien life forms, which first attack, then deliver a haunting word of warning intended for all mankind.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Invisible Invaders
programme.desc: When Dr. Karol Noymann (John Carradine) is killed in an explosion, aliens inhabit his corpse and use it to communicate with his former colleague, Dr. Adam Penner (Philip Tonge), revealing to him that invisible aliens live on the moon. After this revelation, the aliens set out to wipe out humanity by making zombies from their corpses. To survive, Dr. Penner, his daughter (Jean Byron), Dr. John Lamont (Robert Hutton) and Maj. Bruce Jay (John Agar) all hide in a bunker.

programme.title: Attack of the Puppet People
programme.desc: Secretary Sally Reynolds (June Kenny) is grateful to her seemingly kind boss, Mr. Franz (John Hoyt), when he introduces her to a dapper young man, Bob (John Agar). Little does she know that Franz is more than a doll maker. Really, he is really a merciless mad scientist who fights off loneliness by shrinking people and forcing them to serve as his living dolls. But, when he shrinks Sally and her new beau, they refuse to be his playthings and escape into a dangerous world that towers over them.

programme.title: The Monster That Challenged the World
programme.desc: An earthquake doesn't just shake up Southern California -- it awakens a nest of monsters lurking in the Salton Sea. These bloodthirsty sea snails are gobbling up anyone who sets foot in the water. And when the creatures move on to land in search of wider hunting grounds, they launch a reign of terror that threatens to spread across the whole country. Humanity's only hope rests on a crew of intrepid scientists and Lt. Cmdr. John Twillinger (Tim Holt).

programme.title: The Man From Planet X
programme.desc: From his observatory, Scottish professor Elliot (Raymond Bond) keeps close watch on Planet X, whose orbit is coming close to Earth. During the planet's approach, an alien ambassador appears but falls prey to maniacal scientist Dr. Mears (William Schallert). Returning the distinct lack of hospitality, the extraterrestrial uses his otherworldly powers to turn those he encounters into mindless drones. Elliot tries to stop the creature before everyone is turned into a zombie.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: The Beast With a Million Eyes
programme.desc: An alien lands by spaceship and makes birds, cows and other animals attack a ranch family.

programme.title: One Man's Hero
programme.desc: In 1848, Jon Riley heads a group of Irish-born Roman Catholic soldiers in the U.S. Army. The group faces religious prejudice in the predominantly Protestant military. In the midst of the war against Mexico, Riley and some of his fellow soldiers go to a Catholic Church and are cruelly punished as a result. Because of this, they defect to the Mexican Army, where they meet guerrilla leader Cortina, with whom they forge an unlikely bond.

rating.system: Dirección General de Radio, Televisión y Cinematografía
Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação
Instituto de Cinematografía y de las Artes Visuales

programme.title: The Gallant Hours
programme.desc: As he retires from the U.S. Navy, Admiral William J. Halsey (James Cagney) recalls the most daunting challenge in his career: the Battle of Guadalcanal in 1942. Ordered to replace a close friend as fleet admiral, Halsey faces a wily and fierce adversary in Japan's Admiral Yamamoto, and spends the grueling months of the campaign confounding expectations of both the enemy and his own staff. Pained by the losses he knows they will endure, Halsey pushes his forces to the brink.

programme.title: Night Fighters
programme.desc: An Irish rebel (Robert Mitchum) blows the whistle on Nazi collaborators in the Irish Republican Army.

programme.title: Ambush Bay
programme.desc: In 1944, Sgt. Steve Corey (Hugh O'Brian) leads a group of U.S. Marines on a covert mission to an island in the Philippines that is occupied by Japanese forces. There, the soldiers learn that the enemy has planted a series of mines to destroy General MacArthur's incoming troops, who are preparing to storm the island. Before the Marines get a chance to relay the information, they suffer a deadly attack, leaving only the valiant Corey and Pfc. James Grenier (James Mitchum) to save the day.

programme.title: Submarine X-1
programme.desc: Cmdr. Richard Bolton was in charge of a submarine that was sunk by a German ship, and he has been blamed for the loss of 50 sailors. Now exonerated of misconduct, he is heading a mission to use minisubs to reach a German battleship commanded by Capt. Erlich. During training, Bolton encounters some of his previous crew members, all of whom harbor grudges against him, which further complicates the already dangerous mission.

programme.title: Tank Battalion
programme.desc: During the Korean War, Sgt. Brad Dunne (Don Kelly) heads a tank battalion consisting of reluctant young recruit Pfc. Danny Collins (Bob Padget) and seasoned soldiers Corp. Corbett (Edward G. Robinson Jr.) and Pfc. Madigan (Frank Gorshin). When guerrillas launch a series of ambushes on a U.S. base camp, Dunne and his men are ordered to lead an offensive against the rebels. But, just as they approach the front lines, a grenade blast disables their tank, stranding them as the enemy approaches.

programme.title: Beach Red
programme.desc: Ordered to help secure a heavily defended Japanese island during World War II, Captain MacDonald (Cornel Wilde) and his Marines land on "Beach Red" and proceed inland against stubborn, murderous resistance. MacDonald is supported by his tough-as-nails gunnery sergeant (Rip Torn), soulful Private Egan (Burr DeBenning) and a group of stalwart Marines who try to block out the horrors that surround them by remembering the women they love back home.

programme.title: Flight From Ashiya
programme.desc: Stationed in Ashiya, Japan, U.S. Air Force Rescue Service members Master Sgt. Mike Takashima (Yul Brynner), Lt. Col. Glenn Stevenson (Richard Widmark) and Lt. John Gregg (George Chakiris) all carry personal demons stemming from a past event. When the orders come down to rescue stranded Japanese survivors of a shipwreck caused by a storm, the three men jump into action. On their way through the still violent storm, each shares the tale from his past that has affected him to this day.

programme.title: One Man's Hero
programme.desc: In 1848, Jon Riley heads a group of Irish-born Roman Catholic soldiers in the U.S. Army. The group faces religious prejudice in the predominantly Protestant military. In the midst of the war against Mexico, Riley and some of his fellow soldiers go to a Catholic Church and are cruelly punished as a result. Because of this, they defect to the Mexican Army, where they meet guerrilla leader Cortina, with whom they forge an unlikely bond.

programme.title: Submarine X-1
programme.desc: Cmdr. Richard Bolton was in charge of a submarine that was sunk by a German ship, and he has been blamed for the loss of 50 sailors. Now exonerated of misconduct, he is heading a mission to use minisubs to reach a German battleship commanded by Capt. Erlich. During training, Bolton encounters some of his previous crew members, all of whom harbor grudges against him, which further complicates the already dangerous mission.

programme.title: Tank Battalion
programme.desc: During the Korean War, Sgt. Brad Dunne (Don Kelly) heads a tank battalion consisting of reluctant young recruit Pfc. Danny Collins (Bob Padget) and seasoned soldiers Corp. Corbett (Edward G. Robinson Jr.) and Pfc. Madigan (Frank Gorshin). When guerrillas launch a series of ambushes on a U.S. base camp, Dunne and his men are ordered to lead an offensive against the rebels. But, just as they approach the front lines, a grenade blast disables their tank, stranding them as the enemy approaches.

programme.title: Matchless
programme.desc: A New York journalist (Patrick O'Neal) plays global spy with an ancient ring that makes him invisible.

programme.title: Salt and Pepper
programme.desc: Christopher Pepper (Peter Lawford) and Charles Salt (Sammy Davis Jr.) are hip Soho nightclub owners enjoying the good life -- until a secret agent turns up dead in their club. They find her diary and, pursuing the case on their own, discover a sinister plot to overthrow the British government, masterminded by a certain Col. Woodstock (John Le Mesurier). Salt and Pepper have a tough time getting anyone to believe their story until Col. Balsom (Ernest Clark) of MI5 hires them to foil the plot.

programme.title: Topkapi
programme.desc: Beautiful thief Elizabeth Lipp (Melina Mercouri) and criminal genius Walter Harper (Maximilian Schell) put together a plan to steal an emerald-encrusted dagger from Istanbul's Topkapi Palace. As part of their crew, they hire small-time hustler Arthur Simon Simpson (Peter Ustinov) to act as their fall guy. When the Turkish secret police capture Simpson at the border, they persuade him to spy on his partners in crime, mistakenly believing that they're Communist agents plotting an assassination.

programme.title: Cul-de-Sac
programme.desc: When on-the-lam crook Richard (Lionel Stander) and his injured partner-in-crime, Albie (Jack MacGowran), seek shelter in a remote castle by the sea, they find themselves confronted by the owners -- George (Donald Pleasence), an eccentric and weak retiree, and his oversexed wife, Teresa (Françoise Dorléac). Richard seizes control of the castle, but, as the criminals are pulled further into the isolated world of the strange couple, a volatile test of wills ensues.

programme.title: Shield for Murder
programme.desc: Corrupt cop Barney Nolan (Edmond O'Brien) is hard up for cash, so he shoots a bookie, relieves him of $25,000 and makes it look like an accident. While Nolan struggles to keep the crime a secret from his girlfriend, Patty Winters (Marla English), a series of loose ends pop up, and Nolan soon learns that, although committing a crime is easy, getting away with it is murder.

Soon Tibbs is contacted by urban revolutionaries who confess to kidnapping -- but not killing -- the watchman in a botched attempt to expose a heroin ring operating out of the building. Tibbs believes them, but when his superiors learn of his ties to the group, he's suspended from the force.

programme.title: Diary of a Hitman
programme.desc: A veteran hit man, Dekker (Forest Whitaker) is ready to call it quits and leave the profession. Dekker's final job, however, proves to be trickier than expected when the sadistic Zidzyck (Lewis Smith) recruits the assassin to kill his wife, Jain (Sherilyn Fenn), along with the couple's baby. While Dekker has a change of heart and resolves not to shoot Jain and her child, his decision places all their lives in danger, since Zidzyck has dispatched another killer to perform the task.

programme.title: Not as a Stranger
programme.desc: Ambitious medical student Lucas Marsh (Robert Mitchum) aspires to being a doctor with his own practice. Unable to fund his studies himself, he woos the warm, supportive nurse Kristina (Olivia de Havilland), who has the financial resources he needs for him to realize his dreams. The couple marries and moves to a small town, where Lucas works as an assistant to Dr. Runkleman (Charles Bickford). However, after a series of betrayals, Lucas is forced to face life without the help of others.

programme.title: Buona Sera, Mrs. Campbell
programme.desc: During World War II, an Italian villager (Gina Lollobrigida) befriends three American soldiers. Later, when unsure which of them fathered the daughter she has, she invents a dead captain named Campbell, declares herself his widow and accepts support checks from all three soldiers. Twenty years later, a reunion unexpectedly brings the three veterans -- and their wives and children -- back to Italy. Mrs. Campbell panics as she endeavors to keep her lively past from her daughter.

programme.title: Violent Playground
programme.desc: Sgt. Truman (Stanley Baker), a policeman who deals with juvenile delinquents, visits the Murphy household after a theft by the young twins, Mary and Patrick. There he meets their older sister, Cathie (Anne Heywood), and soon begins a romantic involvement with her. However, Cathie's brother, Johnnie (David McCallum), is the leader of an infamous local gang, and doesn't like to see his sister with a cop. Gradually, Truman starts to see a link between Johnnie and a string of local arsons.

programme.title: The Fugitive Kind
programme.desc: When drifter Valentine Xavier (Marlon Brando) arrives in a southern town, he catches the eye of the married Lady Torrance (Anna Magnani) and the oversexed alcoholic, Carol Cutrere (Joanne Woodward). Both vie for his attention, with Lady Torrance emerging victorious, offering Xavier employment in her general store, while her cancer-stricken husband is bedridden upstairs. After impregnating Lady Torrance and butting heads with friends of her husband, Xavier must make a crucial decision.

programme.title: So Young, So Bad
programme.desc: At the Elmview Corrective School for Girls, the facility's warden, Mr. Riggs (Cecil Clovelly), abuses prisoners and justifies his actions as strict discipline. Dr. John H. Jason (Paul Henreid), the school's head psychologist, and Ruth Levering (Catherine McLeod), an assistant, view Riggs' actions as unethical, and believe he's driving the prisoners further toward delinquency. They're proven correct when several girls at the school attempt an escape.

programme.title: Attack on the Iron Coast
programme.desc: With D-Day fast approaching, the Allied forces of World War II prepare to strike a number of strategic Nazi bases. Leading one such attack, Maj. Jamie Wilson (Lloyd Bridges) concocts a risky plan for what is quickly becoming a suicide mission. With a reckless streak that has cost the lives of many men, Wilson faces the opposition of Capt. Owen Franklin (Andrew Keir), whose son was killed in Wilson's last mission. However, Franklin must put aside his feelings when he is ordered to join the major.

programme.title: A Story of David: The Hunted
programme.desc: Renowned for his courageous deeds as a youth when he slew Goliath, David (Jeff Chandler) inadvertently incurs the wrath of King Saul (Basil Sydney), who is jealous of the hero's popularity. In order to provide peace of mind for the Israelite king, Saul's scheming counselor, Doeg (Peter Arne), encourages the ruler to have David killed. David, aided by his friend Jonathan (David Knight), who is Saul's own son, attempts to survive without overtly clashing with his own people.

programme.title: Born Losers
programme.desc: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack (Tom Laughlin) has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington (Elizabeth James) from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

programme.title: The Pride and the Passion
programme.desc: During the Napoleonic Wars, retreating Spanish forces shove a powerful cannon off a cliff to prevent the French from stealing it. The British send Capt. Anthony Turnbull (Cary Grant) to help the Spanish recapture it. When he arrives in Spain, Turnbull finds the cannon secured by Spanish rebels. As Turnbull and the rebel leader Miguel (Frank Sinatra) struggle to transport the cumbersome cannon through the mountains, the British officer falls for beautiful Spaniard Juana (Sophia Loren).

programme.title: Woman of Straw
programme.desc: Charles Richmond (Ralph Richardson), a ruthless millionaire on his deathbed, has decided to leave his entire fortune to charity. His nephew Tony (Sean Connery), who wants to get his hands on his uncle's millions, enlists a beautiful nurse named Maria (Gina Lollobrigida) to seduce and wed Charles, then inherit his wealth. Tony, who is to split the money with Maria after the old man dies, is dismayed when the young woman actually falls for Charles, and has second thoughts about the scheme.

programme.title: The Killer Elite
programme.desc: Friends George Hansen (Robert Duvall) and Mike Locken (James Caan) are hit men who do contract jobs for a company called Com-Teg, associated with the CIA. But, when George gets a better offer from the competition, he turns on Mike, breaking his elbow and shoulder. It takes Mike a long time and a lot of physical therapy to get back on the job, but he does -- and coincidentally finds himself protecting a client whom Hansen and his gang are simultaneously being paid to assassinate.

programme.title: Park Row
programme.desc: Reporter Phineas Mitchell (Gene Evans) works at a successful newspaper, the Star, but does not respect the publication. After sharing his thoughts about a moral and just newspaper at a local pub, he inspires his colleagues to join him in starting a new paper, the Globe, which is an instant hit. However, the publisher of the Star, Charity Hackett (Mary Welch), will not give up her readership easily and orders sabotage on the Globe -- even as Phineas begins to fall for her.

programme.title: The Square Peg
programme.desc: A World War II street laborer (Norman Wisdom) uses his resemblance to a Nazi officer when he is drafted into the British army and captured by German troops.

programme.title: Albino Alligator
programme.desc: When a robbery in New Orleans ends in disaster, the mercurial burglar Dova escapes with his cohorts to a seedy, nearby bar. Capturing all those inside, the criminals trade barbs with the establishment's feisty bartender Janet Boudreaux. The pub becomes highly volatile, however, when the police encircle it; as it turns out, they were already there surveilling another of the bar's patrons, a suspected illicit arms trafficker named Guy Foucard.

programme.title: The Limbic Region
programme.desc: In San Francisco in the 1970s, a serial killer calling himself The Scorekeeper sends taunting notes to the police and media after each of his kills. Although the case is long closed, obsessed detective Jon Lucca (Edward James Olmos) still suspects the wrong man was named as the killer. Learning he has only weeks to live, Lucca meets with Lloyd Ward (George Dzundza) -- the man he has long been convinced is the murderer, but never had enough evidence to arrest -- intending to force a confession.

programme.title: Drum
programme.desc: A slaver (Warren Oates) buys Drum (Ken Norton), a bordello queen's (Silvia Pinal) son, in the 1860s New Orleans.

programme.title: Across 110th Street
programme.desc: After a robbery in Harlem turns into a scene of mass murder, promising young black police officer William Pope (Yaphet Kotto) is assigned to the case, along with surly, prejudiced Italian-American cop Frank Mattelli (Anthony Quinn). The pair clashes during their tense investigation as they try to track down the three suspects and apprehend them. Also searching for the fugitives is ruthless mobster Nick D'Salvio (Tony Franciosa), who will stop at nothing to retrieve the stolen money.

rating.system: Departamento de Justiça, Classificação, Títulos e Qualificação

programme.title: Truck Turner
programme.desc: Bounty hunter Mack "Truck" Turner (Isaac Hayes) almost always finds his target, but his latest prize -- a pimp called Gator (Paul Harris) -- is killed while Turner is chasing him. Gator's girl, Dorinda (Nichelle Nichols), vows to avenge his death and offers ownership of her successful call-girl operation to anyone who can knock off Turner. Upscale pimp Harvard Blue (Yaphet Kotto) steps in, upping the ante with professional assassins. Turner, however, isn't going down easily.

programme.title: Friday Foster
programme.desc: On assignment from her editor, photographer Friday Foster (Pam Grier) travels to an airport to capture a few shots of the richest black man in the United States (Thalmus Rasulala). But it turns out Foster isn't the only one taking shots as she witnesses -- and photographs -- an assassination attempt on her subject. With definitive evidence in her possession, she also becomes a target of the assassins. Joining a private eye (Yaphet Kotto), Foster sets out to discover the truth behind the attempt.

programme.title: The Monkey Hustle
programme.desc: Slick Chicago street hustler Big Daddy Foxx (Yaphet Kotto) lives comfortably off petty confidence scams that he pulls with the help of loyal teenage acolytes Baby D' (Kirk Calloway), Tiny (Donn Harper) and Player (Thomas Carter). His business is jeopardized, however, when he runs afoul of neighborhood racketeer Goldie (Rudy Ray Moore). Their rivalry escalates until the threat of a freeway being built through their neighborhood obliges them to cooperate in order to fight city hall.

programme.title: Census Taker
programme.desc: Fed up with his intrusiveness, members of a family shoot a census taker and try to hide his body from a detective.

programme.title: Carbon Copy
programme.desc: Walter Whitney is a successful executive who resides in an upscale Southern California suburb. Like all of his friends and neighbors, Walter is white, and he is shocked when he learns he has a son he never knew about -- black teen Roger Porter (Denzel Washington). Despite his surprise, Walter welcomes Roger into his home; unfortunately, the less accepting Mrs. Whitney (Susan Saint James) boots both of them out of the house, and Walter's racist boss fires him, leaving him in a tough spot.

programme.title: Amazing Grace
programme.desc: A feisty old woman (Moms Mabley) forces moral support on a big-city candidate (Moses Gunn) for mayor.

programme.title: Five on the Black Hand Side
programme.desc: Mr. Brooks (Leonard Jackson) is an African-American barbershop owner who runs his household with an iron fist. One day, however, Mrs. Brooks (Clarice Taylor) tires of his stern approach and embraces a nonconformist attitude that's more in line with that of their children, including the philosophical Booker T. (D'Urville Martin) and Gideon (Glynn Turman), a black militant. Soon a battle of wills erupts in the Brooks household, and no one is going to readily back down.

programme.title: The Angel Levine
programme.desc: Unable to work due to a back injury, elderly Jewish tailor Morris Mishkin spends his days caring for his ill wife and wishing for happiness. After Morris sees a man die in the street, the man returns to Morris claiming to be a Jewish angel named Alexander Levine, who must perform a miracle within 24 hours to be confirmed as an angel. As his wife's health improves, Morris shows Alexander that renewing his faith may not be so easy.

programme.title: Original Gangstas
programme.desc: Successful Los Angeles football coach John Bookman returns home to Gary, IN, when his father is murdered. Discovering the town overrun with violent street gangs, John is even more horrified to learn his father was shot by a member of the Rebels, a gang John himself helped form in his youth. John teams up with Jake and Laurie, the parents of a boy who was also killed by a Rebel, to organize their neighborhood against gang violence.

programme.title: Eve of Destruction
programme.desc: An anti-terrorist (Gregory Hines) hunts a walking bomb made by a scientist (Renée Soutendijk) in her own image, with all of her hang-ups.

programme.title: J.D.'s Revenge
programme.desc: Although notorious New Orleans gangster J.D. Walker (David McKnight) is shot and killed in the 1940s, his spirit remains restless for three decades, until a hypnotist's supernatural nightclub act allows him to take over the body of Isaac (Glynn Turman), a mild-mannered law student. After inhabiting Isaac, Walker decides to hunt down the Rev. Elija Bliss (Louis Gossett Jr.), a former criminal who helped the authorities find and assassinate the mobster years ago.

programme.title: Act of Vengeance
programme.desc: Five women learn martial arts in order to punish a rapist (Peter Brown) who wears a hockey mask.

programme.title: Black Caesar
programme.desc: Growing up on the tough streets of Harlem, Tommy Gibbs (Fred Williamson) has his life made even harder by John McKinney (Art Lund), a crooked cop who breaks the boy's leg, crippling him for life. Drawing on his anger at the racism he faces on a daily basis, Tommy grows up to become the crime kingpin of Harlem. Now that he has the power, he aims to take down New York's Mafia bosses -- and also get bloody revenge on his nemesis, McKinney, no matter what the cost.

programme.title: Mandela
programme.desc: This documentary follows the beloved South African leader Nelson Mandela from his early days to his presidency, depicting South Africa and its turbulent years during apartheid control, which was brought to an end in 1994 with the nation's democratic election of Mandela as president. Focus is placed on Mandela's early education, his personal relationships, and his political activism for the African National Congress, which led to his 27-year imprisonment for sabotage.

programme.title: Getting Even
programme.desc: Rival Texas chemical magnates (Edward Albert, Joe Don Baker) hold Dallas hostage over nerve gas stolen from the Soviets.

programme.title: Mercenary Fighters
programme.desc: An emerging African nation pits soldiers of fortune (Peter Fonda, Reb Brown, Ron O'Neal) against rebels blocking a dam project.

programme.title: Windprints
programme.desc: Young South African cameraman Anton van Heerden and aging British journalist Charles Rutherford team up to gather information about an apparent Namibian serial killer. In a country ruled by a minority white government, Nhadiep seems only to murder other blacks. His proximity to the strange and horrifying crimes causes Anton to contemplate his role as a privileged white man in a continent where millions of blacks are oppressed.

programme.title: Gun Street
programme.desc: Frank Bogan, a violent criminal sentenced to the death penalty, escapes from prison and vows revenge against those he blames for his capture. Local sheriff Chuck Morton is tasked with warning Bogan's likely victims. At the top of Morton's list are Bogan's ex-wife, Janice; her new husband, Dr. Dean Knudtson; and Jeff Baxley, whose testimony in court helped convict Bogan.

programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: When Rick Martin (Sterling Hayden) goes back to his hometown to warn the townspeople of an imminent attack by marauders, he finds he has been exiled due to his reputation as a gunslinger for hire. Martin discovers that his late mother had been cheated out of her homestead by Canby Judd (William Bishop), who is now affianced to Martin's childhood sweetheart, Laura Mead (Karin Booth). Martin must clear his tarnished name, bring Judd to justice and save the town from the marauders.

programme.title: Red River

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: The Johnstons -- all seven -- of Forsyth, Ga., are the subjects of this reality-documentary series. The brood, TLC says, are "the world's largest known family of achondroplasia dwarfs." Achondroplasia is a genetic disorder of bone growth, but the series demonstrates that size only matters in the amount of love the Johnstons provide. Trent, a grounds supervisor at a local college, and housewife Amber have two biological children -- Jonah and Elizabeth -- while Anna, Alex and Emma were adopted from Russia, Korea and China, respectively. Episodes deal with everything from high-drama soccer tryouts to a disastrous attempt at a "birds and bees" discussion, all framed by the family tackling a massive renovation of their 6,000-square-foot, circa 1891 home.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: ¿Quién tiene la razón?
programme.desc: Programa de charlas en el que los participantes invitados exponen sus casos ante la presentadora buscando consejo profesional. Los casos incluyen conflictos en temas variados, entre familias, parejas y amigos o relacionados. Ella guía con preguntas y consejos a los participantes y en muchos casos los confronta y acusa para que acepten sus errores cometidos por hecho o negligencia. A su lado la acompañan un grupo de tres panelistas, quienes eligen individualmente con quién están de acuerdo o en desacuerdo, después de haber escuchado atentamente a las partes en cuestión. También acompañando a la doctora Âlvarez está la audiencia presente en el estudio formando parte activa del show; la cual entrega el veredicto final, eligiendo por votación al panelista que tiene la razón o en algunos casos concluyendo que ninguno tiene la razón.

programme.title: Casos de familia
programme.desc: Personas comunes y corrientes se reúnen en el escenario para exponer sus historias reales y dramas personales, ellos comentan sus casos ante la audiencia presente y ante el público televidente. La anfitriona del programa se encarga de conducir a los panelistas para exponer sus casos en forma clara, sacar una conclusión al problema y tratar de solucionarlo, gracias a su carisma y habilidad para conectarse con sus invitados de una manera positiva con sus análisis objetivos, ella, por lo general encuentra la solución a los conflictos. Los temas tratados son diversos, incluyendo conflictos familiares, problemas entre socios, infidelidad, paternidad, entre otros.

programme.title: Historias de la Virgen morena
programme.desc: A veces los problemas del día a día pueden solucionarse con un poco de ayuda milagrosa. Esta exitosa serie muestra casos de la vida real en los cuales los protagonistas se enfrentan a grandes encrucijadas o a situaciones terribles, y no les queda más remedio que pedir un milagro. Es allí cuando la fe se pone a prueba y se vuelve poderosa, pues demuestra que de la situación más terrible se puede salir. Pensado para quienes creen que la fe mueve montañas, esta conmovedora serie muestra la manera en la que los protagonistas se encomiendan a la Virgen Morena buscando resolver sus dificultades.

Esta serie creada por su anfitrión Alfonso Lizarazo, le ha dado la oportunidad a talentos desconocidos de llegar al estrellato, este espacio ha sido una plataforma para los que han sido aclamados como los mejores comediantes del país. programme.desc: Los mexicanos son los hijos del maíz, así lo dicen los mitos prehispánicos. Este alimento característico ha evolucionado hasta convertirse en la piedra fundacional de la cocina y la vida en México. Pepe Gordon conversa con Cristina Barros Valero, maestra en Letras por la UNAM y una de las mayores divulgadores de la cultura culinaria mexicana, para conversar sobre la relevancia nutricional, histórica, cultural, genética y, por supuesto, gastronómica, del maíz en México.

programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

programme.title: Planeta helado
programme.desc: El equipo que produjo la serie ganadora del premio Emmy, "Planet Earth" de la Unidad de Historia Natural de la BBC y de Discovery Channel combinan sus esfuerzos una vez más para crear este documental magnífico de siete partes. Grabado en su totalidad en alta definición e incluye cinematografía con tecnología de punta, para capturar el comportamiento de los animales sin ser disturbados, este programa hace una crónica de los ecosistemas y de los animales del Ártico y el Antártico, lugares en el que los cineastas pasaron 2.300 días y en el océano 18 meses para grabar cortos sin precedentes. Los episodios siguen las vidas de los osos polares, los lobos, las ballenas asesinas y los pingüinos, desde la primavera hasta el invierno y además hay un episodio que detalla los desafíos enfrentados por el equipo que realizó el documental. La serie es narrada por Alec Baldwin y el séptimo episodio incluye una visión sobre los efectos del calentamiento global en los polos y el resto.

programme.title: 五毒天羅 / The Web of Death
programme.desc: 《五毒天羅》是武林至毒之物，不知收藏何方。五毒教的蛇壇主，要找出天羅所在，獨霸武林，誤放消息，謂天羅已重現武林，江湖一片風聲鶴唳….

programme.title: 鳳還巢 / Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: 兵部侍郎程浦將次女雪娥許配予好友之子穆居易，庶室程夫人既憤且惱，對居易訛稱長女雪雁乃雪娥，催促二人早日成親。居易見雪雁貌醜而癡，嚇得留書出走。富豪朱煥然對雪娥心儀已久，趁此良機冒充居易，依期迎親……本片由李香君、金峰分飾男、女主角，配搭新鮮；而蔣光超與莊元庸一胖一瘦的諧趣演出，更令人笑破肚皮。.

programme.title: 奇門怪招爛頭蟀 / The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: 受到《醉拳》啟發，這部功夫喜劇描述一名傻頭傻腦的功夫小子自創了一套蟋蟀拳，其後更逐一打敗曾欺凌他的武林人士。.

programme.title: 娃娃夫人 / The Merry Wife
programme.desc: 三十五歲的男教師林明娶了十七歲的女學生珍珍。兩人在同一學校上課，隱藏夫妻秘密。珍發覺林明常被女生包圍，而林又發現珍常被男老師追求，期間笑料百出。.

programme.title: 文素臣 / The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: 「龍門七俠」之首文素臣命六俠入昭慶寺探察，他們不慎被主持明空殺害。明空更設計殺害林巡按，幸得文所救。文素臣潛入寺內與明空一戰為六俠報仇，林巡按下令官兵攻入昭慶寺，聯合文殲滅所有奸僧。.

programme.title: 阿牛發達記 / Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: 阿牛拾得一袋珠寶，從此富貴。這時，周大叔假意叫他簽約迎娶一名女子，却原來是個陷阱，為的是要賣掉他的房子。最後，可憐的阿牛又回復一貧如洗….

programme.title: 儒俠 / The Silent Swordsman
programme.desc: 年輕劍客沈秉義受命出任愛國組織「日月會」總舵主，誓要討伐勾結外敵、禍國殃民的大將軍。在捨身報國的征途中，他先後邂逅豪爽女俠與兩位美若天仙的維族公主。面對國仇家恨與三段纏綿深情，這位劍客陷入了情義兩難的抉擇。.

programme.title: 鑽石艷盜 / The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: 兩大珠寶盜賊「夜來香」和「夜爵士」前往日本，意圖偷去「維納斯的眼淚」巨鑽。二人見面後即墜入愛河，卻不知道原來對方同為盜取巨鑽的競敵。最後誰會得到巨鑽？二人的戀情又會否無疾而終？.

programme.title: 陸小鳳之決戰前後 / The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: 兩大武林劍客葉孤城與西門吹雪將於紫禁城決鬥。陸小鳳忖度二人素末謀面，又無利益衝突，無須決鬥，猜想當中一定事有蹊蹺。於是，他決定和花滿樓前往京城調查清楚，卻發現當中隱藏的陰謀….

programme.title: 王昭君 / Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師，於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君後，驚為天人，即選中她。畫師被逐後，為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親。皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰，以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己。.

programme.title: 英雄無淚 / Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: 江湖异人蕭大師鑄成寶劍「泪痕劍」，不料該劍顯現出凶兆，將會帶來武林浩劫，而他的親生子注定要死在此劍之下。蕭爲了使此劍不危害江湖，將它交給一位淡薄名利的弟子保管。數十年後該弟子把它傳給門徒小高，令其帶劍下山望化解江湖劫數。.

programme.title: 沒有老公的日子 / Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: 黃太太獨力撫養兒子Alex成人，與媳婦阿彤一起生活。豈料Alex意外逝世，死前道出外遇女友黑仔已懷有身孕。結果三名沒有老公的女人同住一室...

programme.title: 盤絲洞 / The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: 本片為邵氏「西遊記」系列的第三部作品。唐僧落入了七位蜘蛛精的手中，希望食唐僧肉而得到永生。悟空、八戒和沙僧因此大鬧盤絲洞拯救唐僧。.

programme.title: 茅山殭屍拳 / The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍，啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍，而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是，此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技，二人皆為深不可測的武林高手！.

programme.title: 茅山殭屍拳 / The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: 以「趕屍」為業的陳師父與徒弟受託押運九具殭屍，啟程上路。未料途中兩具竟逃脫。其中一具實際上並非殭屍，而是為躲避敵人追殺而假扮的江湖豪客。更令人意外的是，此人與陳師父同樣身懷絕技，二人皆為深不可測的武林高手！.

programme.title: 中國超人 / Super Inframan
programme.desc: 太空科學研究深所獲悉有來自冰河時代的人類所化之怪物將會危及地球上的所有人類。這批怪物兇悍異常，神通廣大，大有霸佔整個世界的野心。為了對付這批怪物，科學研究所所長劉英德以自己數十年來的研究心得把勇敢的科學研究員雷馬製造成萬能超人。中國超人開始了與怪物的戰鬥…….

programme.title: 大地兒女 / Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: 這是一部經典戰爭鉅片，描述抗日戰爭時人民的生活狀況。畫家俞瑞意外救了由鄉下被拐賣來的女子荷花。兩人互生情愫，不久更結為夫妻過著幸福的日子。無奈好景不常，不久日軍全面侵入中國，亦正式展開殘酷的統治….

programme.title: 邪鬥邪 / Hex Vs Witchcraft
programme.desc: 餘腩沉溺賭海，由於欠債累累無力償還，遂答應債主以其妻肉償債項。事件被其妻識破，並決意離餘而去。餘動輕生念頭，可最終自殺未遂。餘遇上一名富家老伯，老伯答應給餘巨額現金，只要餘答應幫他娶得美人歸...

programme.title: 插翅難飛 / The Convict Killer
programme.desc: 鄧彪因為黑貨買賣失手，遂逼江湖人物高明供出從中陷害者，高明說出乃黑豹所為後，即被開槍殺死，鄧彪因此被判監禁十五年。他出獄後即找黑豹報仇，卻遇上勢力龐大的葛八爺幹擾；同時商琳為尋失蹤十五年的丈夫，欲找鄧彪查問黑豹下落，但兩人僅聽過黑豹其名，從未見其人，究竟黑豹是誰？.

programme.title: 仙女下凡 / The Human Goddess
programme.desc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活，某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟，險遭不法之徒欺騙，幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼，七妹屢施法術相助，卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持，情愫漸生，共同守護孤兒院的未來。.

programme.title: 西遊記 / The Monkey Goes West
programme.desc: 本片根據中國經典同名名著改編。故事講述唐僧赴西天取經，中途在五指山收服馬騮精；在高家莊收服豬八戒；在流沙河收服沙悟淨的種種情節。。.

programme.title: 舞衣 / Sex, Love and Hate
programme.desc: 歌星白眉有一豪宅，與空姐朱黛、舞女姚姚同住，三女各有愛情際遇；白眉雖愛錢，卻傾情自稱從外地來的路俊，兩人只好互許後會有期之願；朱黛曾迷戀已婚飛機師，分手後又愛上賽車手；姚姚的最大心願是把清白之軀留給丈夫，她本最愛窮工人李吉，李吉卻因自卑而忍痛分手，姚姚嫁予富家子，卻仍掛念李吉...

programme.title: 來如風 / The Swift Knight
programme.desc: 明皇身染惡疾，駕崩在即，卻無子可繼帝位；皇侄世子傑本可繼位，惜不成器，難當大任。皇弟徽王想起明皇曾與東宮宮女生有子女各一，現時藏匿于東陽縣，遂命锦衣衛劉玄平尋找公主與王子的下落。劉玄平路上屢遭世子傑爪牙追殺，幸得俠士來如風相助...

programme.title: 蛇王子 / The Snake Prince
programme.desc: 廣西蛇山中有三條巨蛇──蛇王子、黑蛇將及黃蛇將；一夜三蛇化成人形與苗寨男女載歌載舞，蛇王子更因此愛上苗寨女子黑琴。後苗寨旱災，蛇王子答應率蛇作法，引水入寨，但條件是要娶黑琴為妻...

programme.title: 蕩寇誌 / All Men are Brothers
programme.desc: 張徹導演的武俠鉅作《水滸傳》的延續。七大梁山的英雄義士為保國家，奉命征討宦官專權。展開一場轟轟烈烈之蕩寇大決戰。.

programme.title: 青春戀 / Young Lovers
programme.desc: 酷愛音樂的留學生李英偉臨危受命替老父接管公司，其嬉皮士形像為祖母不屑。李的公司職員林仲鵬乘機製造事端，圖謀奪取其總經理之職位。李之青梅竹馬朋友王鳳不忍見李受屈，化身金髮美人巧施妙計助他解困，自此李對此神秘女郎一見鍾情 。.

programme.title: 武林風雲 / A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: 故事描述，武義親王恃勢弄權，為奪紫光劍，不惜害死甘大雄、迫走徐牧，並命其子魯天霞率惡家奴直闖甘家堡，借弔祭為名，實以武力奪劍。甘氏三女勝男、亞男、超男惶然之際，表親徐進到訪，聯手殺退惡奴，但大戰中，徐進、勝男等受傷，無恙的亞男遂往飛虎嶺邀救兵…….

programme.title: 冰天俠女 / Vengeance Of A Snow Girl
programme.desc: 沈冰紅幼時目擊父母遭高允及結拜弟兄殺害，雙腳更被凍至殘廢；長大後練就非凡武功，矢志復仇。後冰紅與高允次子高天英結識，天英雖知冰紅為報仇而來，卻對她的遭遇非常同情，主動為她治好腳疾…….

programme.title: 鬼畫符 / The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: 周鵬被神捕諸葛森追殺，投靠表兄包妥。林家大少奶被男鬼杜洛所殺，要求鵬二人帶其鬼魂上路，到開封找公孫先生消滅杜鬼魂。鵬以大少奶的鬼符在賭場贏取路費，更與戲子吳順超一同上路...

programme.title: 鬼畫符 / The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: 周鵬被神捕諸葛森追殺，投靠表兄包妥。林家大少奶被男鬼杜洛所殺，要求鵬二人帶其鬼魂上路，到開封找公孫先生消滅杜鬼魂。鵬以大少奶的鬼符在賭場贏取路費，更與戲子吳順超一同上路...

programme.title: 藍與黑續集 / The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: 劇情承接上集，唐琪結束夜總會歌女生涯，在戰亂中跑遍中國尋找愛人張醒亞，但醒亞卻糾纏於日軍，叛亂分子及將軍的美麗女兒當中。.

programme.title: 成記茶樓 / The Tea House
programme.desc: 大哥成從大陸逃到香港，在屋邨經營茶樓，本想安分守己，卻屢遭惡勢力挑釁，而警方卻袖手旁觀，迫使大哥成和茶樓的朋友們決定以牙還牙！.

programme.title: 林沖夜奔 / Pursuit
programme.desc: 此片述說了關於林沖的故事。宋朝禁軍教頭林沖遭受貪官陷害，被放逐滄州，更陷入險境。幸得花和尚相助，林沖成功脫險，更展開復仇大計。.

programme.title: 邪完再邪 / Hex after Hex
programme.desc: 女鬼劉阿翠鍾情以前鄰居馬素，欲與其結合，央求父親攜同金銀珠寶向馬提親，撮合一段人鬼姻緣，馬素年青憨直，不願與鬼為伍，堅決拒絕，實則彼暗戀已有男友之鄰居紅卜卜，阿翠洞悉其情，決定伺機行動。.

programme.title: 廣東十虎與後五虎 / Ten Tigers of Kwang Tung
programme.desc: 廣東十虎之一譚敏之侄譚聰，在賭館當巡場；一夜，十虎的徒弟及後人等四人，在賭場相聚時，旗人佟七帶著前清官之子小虎突襲，把譚聰殺死。原因是十虎之黎仁昭、譚敏等，昔日曾把父殺死，以助反清義士蔡民義脫險。小虎遂與師叔們聯手，殺死仍在世的十虎及其後人、傳人，為父報仇...

programme.title: 至尊一劍 / The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: 魔山派秦五新劍術高超，連敗九十九名劍手，終在最後一擊敗在劍神手上。五新知其欠缺一柄寶劍，遂殺死著名鑄劍師老鷹，奪取稀世的「老鷹寶劍」。老鷹之子燕北悲痛萬分，矢誓報仇，不自量力挑戰五新，結果被打落懸崖之下...

programme.title: 唐人街功夫小子 / Chinatown Kid
programme.desc: 青年譚東獨自從大陸來港投靠祖父，因與黑社會人物徐豪結怨而遭陷害，迫於無奈偷渡到三藩市。東在唐人街飯店覓得工作，後來又因打抱不平而再牽涉入黑幫恩怨中。東更重遇徐豪，二人展開連場惡戰。.

programme.title: 奸人鬼 / A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: 男孩小吉的父母離異後，希望尋找快樂的人生。一天，小吉喜遇好心鬼簡人，並結成好友。好心鬼決定要幫助小吉的父母復合，令小吉得到真正的快樂。.

programme.title: 玉面飛狐 / The Silver Fox
programme.desc: 夏梧與司馬秋同為鏢局掌門義子。司馬秋利慾薰心，設計弒殺師父，更以暗鏢毀去夏梧面容。重傷的夏梧懷抱年幼長女逃走，懷孕妻子卻於昏迷中遭司馬秋姦污。夏梧隱居深山，將仇恨寄託長女青青，苦心培育其成為武藝高強的「玉面飛狐」，命她下山劫鏢尋仇。.

programme.title: 艷陽天 / Blue Skies
programme.desc: 鋼琴師李燕南與樂隊指揮女兒陳小芸相愛，常指點她歌唱技巧。小芸在一次代替演出中一鳴驚人，得團主及花花公子杜邦傑力捧。小芸赴星馬演出，心卻惦念燕南，一夜與杜邦傑于車內發生爭執，怎料汽車失事...

programme.title: 豪俠傳 / Killers Five
programme.desc: 平西王因與金龍山強盜結仇，女兒被擄走。他非常焦急，請劍俠岳震北幫忙，嶽估計一人之力不夠，幸得多位武功高強的好友相助一同去金龍山破盜寨。各人步步小心，希望能成功救人。.

programme.title: 獵人 / Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: 花花公子周國雄有一本「獵人日記」專門去記錄他四出獵艷的故事，周丟棄劉明華，又去追獵呂綺美，劉突然遭人殺死。後來周又去追求女學生朱麗珍…但當晚，呂遭殺死，警方向周追查。同時周想到和他親近的女人，一個一個的被殺死，嫌兇漸指向他，好像有人在陷害自己。周開始追查真相。.

programme.title: 洪拳與詠春 / Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: 清廷派人掃平少林寺，殺掉所有少林弟子。從中倖存出來的兩名弟子，分別拜入詠春及洪拳師傅門下，學習拳法。最終他們挾技擊敗敵人，並為死去師兄弟報仇。.

programme.title: 野姑娘 / Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女，面對惡霸從不退縮，總是勇敢反抗。當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後，立刻引來他的狠毒報復。幸好，她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救。兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運，改寫結局？.

programme.title: 野姑娘 / Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女，面對惡霸從不退縮，總是勇敢反抗。當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後，立刻引來他的狠毒報復。幸好，她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救。兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運，改寫結局？.

programme.title: 裸血 / Raw Passions
programme.desc: 淩波的丈夫高遠及其友王俠，均與肚皮舞女郎孟莉有染，孟藉此勒索二人；後孟被殺，高成嫌疑犯，另孟之兄翟諾，亦向高勒索；而淩在家，也接見了穀峰，他聲言有為高洗罪的證據，但要索錢；王妻李香君借貸給淩... 究竟誰是殺孟真凶？.

programme.title: 玉女嬉春 / The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: 呂紫英陪同父呂天奇到台灣發展，兩姐白虹、青萍留港繼續歌舞生涯。白虹認識江慶良後投契相戀，江向老闆引薦白虹在歌劇中當主角，老父回來見三位女兒成就，開心不已。.

programme.title: 勾魂降頭 / Black Magic 2
programme.desc: 青年醫生時振聲在醫院中發現很多奇難雜症，無法以醫學理論解釋，遂請好友齊中平夫婦共同研究。幾經追查，才發現那些病人均是中了降頭。原來施降者是精通邪術，以「愛情降頭」協助富商追求夢中情人，博取巨額報酬。中平不信妖邪之說，其妻子更不惜以身相試，更被施以「死降」，如果無法破解，二十四小時後便會身亡….

programme.title: 教頭 / The Kung-fu Instructor
programme.desc: 河東府教頭王陽受地方土紳孟二達陷害，成殺人疑犯，惟匿藏孟家任教頭。後王收好武青年周平為徒，卻惹孟不滿；原來周、孟兩大族為死敵，孟覺聘王當教頭，實乃養虎為患，遂唆使大盜「一條鞭」施以偷襲，幸王逃過大難，只是受了傷。孟家有寄居少女嘉嘉向不值孟氏所為，且對王很有好感，遂暗中援手...

programme.title: 鐵扇公主 / Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: 唐僧師徒西行取經，受阻於烈火綿延的火焰山，唯有鐵扇公主的芭蕉扇方能滅火。然而因紅孩兒一事，牛魔王夫婦拒不相助。孫悟空遂與二人展開「三調芭蕉扇」的智勇較量。越過火焰山後，師徒不幸落入白骨精姐妹設下的長生圈套。面對詭計多端的妖精，悟空再施神通，護師脫險。.

programme.title: 血手印 / The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: 窮書生林肇德與富翁女兒訂親，但富翁因其家道中落而反對婚事。為迎娶摯愛，肇德上京考取功名，臨行前會晤未婚妻，怎料卻碰上婢女滿身鮮血伏屍後花園。因不慎留下血手印於門上，他更被誣陷殺人。直至包公及時重審，為他洗脫冤情。.

programme.title: 保鏢 / Have Sword Will Travel
programme.desc: 洛陽無敵莊莊主失去了所有功力，於是請來侄兒與未婚妻一起護送黃金前往京城。在途中，他們遇到了一名神秘俠客，三人隨即聯手對抗盜匪，竭力保護黃金不被劫走。.

programme.title: 少林傳人 / Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: 九王爺謀朝篡位，率領奸臣叛賊攻入皇宮；皇帝見大勢已去，命兩名忠心侍衛各抱一名太子突圍而出。輾轉之下，大太子由少林戒律院三僧撫養，法號道行，習得少林絕技；二太子則易名五子泰，由丞相撫養。多年後，五子泰前往少林寺借閱「易筋經」，與道行相遇，卻不知對方正是親兄弟…….

programme.title: 十二金錢鏢 / Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: 喬茂押鏢時，遇女贼袁玉蓉，舉刀要殺之際，卻被袁的美麗媚態吸引，後兩人互生愛慕，更發現憑獨門武器「十二金錢鏢」名震天下的俞劍平，與背後操控袁的老頭，有段血海深仇….

programme.title: 雲泥 / When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: 女主角熊素素因不能接受機師男友意外身亡而患上精神分裂症，一天巧遇留學歸來的精神科醫生黎易非，多次奇幻的相遇令易非和素素捲入三角戀和複雜的內心糾結之中。.

programme.title: 單程路 / One Way Only
programme.desc: 李修賢是一摩托車行東主，曾是著名車手，惟一次意外中傷殘；他對學徒麥德羅甚為賞識，麥因李之啟蒙而在澳門賽車中奪標。李聞悉麥參與非法賽車，予以規勸，惟麥受盛名之累，欲罷不能….

programme.title: 魂斷奈何天 / Dawn will Come
programme.desc: 良才見秋容貌美，心懷不軌，竟將其迷姦。秋容醒來後為良才甜言蜜意所惑，相信他稟明父母後會娶她為妻。誰知數月後，良才音訊全無，秋容更發現自已懷有身孕，於是馬上去找良才。可惜那時秋容才發現良才已另娶名門閨秀為妻，更打算將秋容滅口….

programme.title: 七煞 / To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: 由七位壇主控制的「七煞會」，在江湖上掀起腥風血雨, 人人聞風喪膽。朝廷特派刑部尚書楊宇統籌剿滅，並派臥底從內瓦解組織，隨著「七煞會」內衝突不斷升溫，幕後壇主可會找出臥底？.

programme.title: Senandung Yang Tak Didengar
programme.desc: Raina (Aline Fauziah) selalu dibandingkan dengan kakaknya, Vinka (Hanifa Alhasni). Raina yang dituntut untuk sempurna menjadikan musik satu-satunya pelarian dari luka dan tekanan. Di tengah ejekan teman-temannya, Abhay (Rassya Hidayah) hadir sebagai pelindung dan penyemangatnya.

programme.title: Kesan Pertama Pesonamu Langsung Menggoda
programme.desc: Hidup Arga (Emyr Razan) penuh luka dan perjuangan. Tapi takdir memberi Arga kesempatan kedua, termasuk untuk bertemu kembali dengan Rina (Larasati Nugroho), cinta pertamanya yang kini jadi gurunya. Bagaimana kisah selanjutnya? Saksikan selengkapnya hanya di FTV SCTV - Kesan Pertama Pesonamu Langsung Menggoda

programme.title: Bidadari Surgamu
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah seorang gadis bernama Sakinah yang menjalani hidup penuh tekanan karena fitnah dan dipaksa menikah dengan orang yang tidak mencintainya. Tidak hanya itu, Sakinah bahkan dihalangi untuk tau siapa Ibu kandung yang tega membuangnya. Bagaimana kelanjutan kisah hidup Sakinah?

programme.title: Cinta Dua Pilihan
programme.desc: Fathir dan Sukma adalah sepasang suami istri yang hidup sederhana namun bahagia. Sampai akhirnya sang buah hati Zahra divonis menderita sakit yang serius ditengah keluarga mereka yang masih serba kekurangan. Disaat bersamaan, Fathir tidak sengaja bertemu dengan mantannya Clara. Kehadiran Clara mengubah segalanya.

programme.title: Naik Ranjang
programme.desc: Setelah terpisah selama 20 tahun, Tyas berusaha mencari ayahnya, Mahdi, untuk menjadi wali pernikahannya dengan Gino. Setelah bertemu Mahdi, tunangan Tyas, Gino tampak terkejut menemukan Hani, adik Tyas yang telah memiliki anak dari hubungan mereka di masa lalu.

programme.title: Ketika Jamu Tak Berhenti Di Sini
programme.desc: kehidupan seorang gadis bernama Molly (Djihan Ranti). Demi mencukupi kebutuhan sehari-hari, Molly dan adiknya berjualan jamu instan di dalam botol di kampus. Usaha Molly dan adiknya itu pun mendapatkan perhatian dari teman-teman kampusnya hingga jamunya banyak dibeli dan pemasarannya dibantu temannya. Meski demikian, Molly masih kesulitan dalam memenuhi kebutuhan hidupnya hingga membayar kos pun ditagih-tagih. Suatu hari, ada peristiwa yang mendekatkan Molly dengan seorang pria bernama Vian (Julian Jacob). Molly dan Vian pun menjadi dekat hingga menimbulkan kecemburuan pacar Vian.

programme.title: Katanya Hidup Itu Indah
programme.desc: Cakra (Munggaran Meldrat) harus kehilangan kakak dan kakak iparnya yang meninggal dunia dan meninggalkan 3 anak yang masih kecil. Demi memenuhi kewajibannya sebagai tulang punggung, Cakra pun bekerja serabutan. Saat sedang berjualan keliling, tanpa sengaja Cakra bertemu dengan Mona (Zoe Jackson) sahabat perempuannya saat kuliah.

programme.title: Malam Minggu Bersama Nenek
programme.desc: Raka (Fandy Christian) bertemu Alya (Amanda Salma) saat malam minggu bersama neneknya. Dari pertemuan sederhana itu, tumbuh benih cinta yang diuji oleh perbedaan dunia mereka.

Pertengkaran kecil sering terjadi di antara mereka, mulai dari hal sepele sampai yang bikin emosi. Tapi justru dari situ, benih-benih cinta mulai tumbuh. programme.title: Ketika Jamu Tak Berhenti Di Sini
programme.desc: kehidupan seorang gadis bernama Molly (Djihan Ranti). Demi mencukupi kebutuhan sehari-hari, Molly dan adiknya berjualan jamu instan di dalam botol di kampus. Usaha Molly dan adiknya itu pun mendapatkan perhatian dari teman-teman kampusnya hingga jamunya banyak dibeli dan pemasarannya dibantu temannya. Meski demikian, Molly masih kesulitan dalam memenuhi kebutuhan hidupnya hingga membayar kos pun ditagih-tagih. Suatu hari, ada peristiwa yang mendekatkan Molly dengan seorang pria bernama Vian (Julian Jacob). Molly dan Vian pun menjadi dekat hingga menimbulkan kecemburuan pacar Vian.

programme.title: Katanya Hidup Itu Indah
programme.desc: Cakra (Munggaran Meldrat) harus kehilangan kakak dan kakak iparnya yang meninggal dunia dan meninggalkan 3 anak yang masih kecil. Demi memenuhi kewajibannya sebagai tulang punggung, Cakra pun bekerja serabutan. Saat sedang berjualan keliling, tanpa sengaja Cakra bertemu dengan Mona (Zoe Jackson) sahabat perempuannya saat kuliah.

programme.desc: Rara rela berpura-pura jadi pawang hujan buat bayar hutang dan membiayai pengobatan Babehnya, tapi malah ketemu Angga, pemilik WO yang nggak percaya hal-hal mistis. Kedekatan mereka membuatnya saling jatuh cinta, tapi situasi kian rumit ketika Angga tahu kebohongan Rara dan melaporkannya ke polisi. Namun, berakhir bahagia.

programme.title: My Beautiful (Ex) Sister
programme.desc: Juna (Rizky Alatas) beserta kakak dan babehnya (Tenno Ali), mengalami kecelakaan yang menyebabkan kakaknya Juna meninggal. Padahal saat itu adalah hari bahagia kakaknya yang ingin melamar Karin (Kharisma Adzana). Mendengar kabar bahwa kekasihnya meninggal, Karin sangat sedih. Karin seperti tidak mempunyai semangat untuk hidup. Babeh yang sudah menganggap Karin sebagai anak, meminta Juna menggantikan posisi kakaknya untuk menikah dengan Karin.

programme.title: Amazing Entertainment : Bhootu
programme.desc: Bhootu adalah drama komedi anak-anak yang ditayangkan di Zee Bangla. Serial ini berkisah tentang hantu gadis ramah, Bhootu, yang selalu berusaha membantu orang lain, sering kali menyebabkan kerusakan ringan dan kekacauan dalam prosesnya.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Cocomelon Dan Sahabat
programme.desc: Cocomelon merupakan seri animasi yang menceritakan kehidupan sehari-hari JJ, saudara-saudaranya, dan teman-temannya dalam dunia yang cerah dan penuh warna. Melalui lagu, permainan, dan petualangan sederhana, mereka belajar tentang keluarga, sopan santun, angka, huruf, serta nilai-nilai moral seperti tolong-menolong dan kasih sayang.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Bernard Bear
programme.desc: Bernard Bear adalah sebuah animasi pendek ber-genre serial televisi anak-anak. Animasi ini menceritakan tentang Bernard, seekor beruang kutub, yang selalu sial di setiap episodenya akibat ulahnya atau tokoh lain

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Pada Zaman Dahulu
programme.desc: Pada Zaman Dahulu adalah serial animasi yang mengangkat kisah fabel rakyat Melayu, terutama kecerdikan Sang Kancil. Cerita berpusat pada Aki yang menceritakan dongeng kepada dua cucunya, Aris dan Ara, yang tinggal bersamanya di kampung. Animasi ini mengandung nilai moral, nasihat kehidupan, dan hiburan.

programme.title: Amazing Kids : Kiko
programme.desc: Animasi Kiko mengisahkan petualangan Kiko, seekor anak ikan mas koki yang mandiri dan riang, bersama empat sahabat setianya: Lola (ikan diskus), Ting Ting (kepiting), Patino (ikan patin), dan Poli (ikan cupang). Mereka menjalani berbagai kisah seru dan memecahkan masalah di bawah laut.

programme.title: Amazing Entertainment : Legend.Ai Nusantara
programme.desc: Legend.AI Nusantara menampilkan Cerita Rakyat Nusantara Dengan Visual Yang Menarik, Memanfaatkan Teknologi AI Terkini Sebagai Ilustrasi Cerita Guna Memberikan Informasi Dan Hiburan Tentang Warisan Cerita Budaya Indonesia.

programme.title: Big Movies
programme.desc: Program yang menjadikan berbagai jenis film mulai dari petualangan, horror hingga aksi.

programme.title: Masha & The Bear
programme.desc: Seekor beruang sirkus pensiunan menetap di hutan dan bersiap untuk kehidupan baru yang tenang dikelilingi oleh kedamaian dan ketenangan sampai dia diperkenalkan dengan seorang gadis kecil petualang bernama Masha. Masha adalah seorang gadis Rusia yang tinggal di hutan bersama babi, kambing, dan anjingnya.

programme.title: Keluarga Somat
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Keluarga yang membahas kehidupan masyarakat sehari-hari melalui tokoh utama, Pak Somat , Bu Inah, Dudung, Ninung dan warga lainnya yang ber-Bhinneka Tunggal Ika.

programme.title: Blippi Visits
programme.desc: Jelajahi dunia bersama Blippi saat ia melakukan perjalanan seru ke berbagai lokasi. Jadilah penasaran seperti Blippi tentang dunia, dengan musim episode tentang Perjalanan Blippi ini!

programme.title: Puzzle Code Of Shanmiao And Jimi
programme.desc: ShanMiao dan JiMi bekerja sama untuk memecahkan teka-teki sementara GuLi dan XinKe yang nakal terus membuat masalah! Malaikat kecil dan pengacau yang egois menghadapi tantangan dengan cara yang berbeda untuk mencapai impian mereka. Kode teka-teki, siapa yang akan menjadi pemenang akhir?

programme.title: Tim Penyelamat Tayo
programme.desc: Pergi tim penyelamat! Lindungi kota! Kendaraan penyelamat baru, mobil polisi, dan truk pemadam kebakaran datang untuk menyelamatkan!

programme.title: Howie, Landau'S Adventures In Seabed
programme.desc: Seri ini menyampaikan nilai-nilai persahabatan, keberanian, keyakinan dan pengampunan kepada anak-anak dan menceritakan kisah-kisah yang dialami Howie dan Landau di dasar laut. Howie, seorang penemu cilik dan Landau, seorang ahli pengetahuan kelautan, pergi ke laut dalam secara tidak sengaja. Mereka datang ke Kerajaan Merman dan terlibat dalam krisis besar di dunia laut.

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Saatnya Ash dan Pikachu memulai petualangan mereka di wilayah Kalos! Sepanjang jalan, mereka bergabung dengan beberapa teman baru seorang penemu jenius bernama Clemont, adik perempuannya Bonnie, dan Serena, seorang Pelatih dalam perjalanan pertamanya. Ash segera mencoba menantang Gym di Lumiose City, tetapi tidak terlalu jauh sebelum robot mengusirnya! Di sela-sela pertarungan Gym, Ash dan teman-temannya akan menjelajahi wilayah unik ini, bertemu semua jenis Pokemon baru, dan mencari misteri Pokemon baru yang menarik!

programme.title: Bedu Dan Adul
programme.desc: Bedu dan Adul adalah sebuah serial film animasi 3D tentang petualangan anak-anak di kawasan pinggiran Jakarta.

programme.title: Arpo The Robot Season 3
programme.desc: Arpo dirancang sebagai robot komando, dibangun sebagai mesin tempur yang ganas. Namun, dengan tercapainya perdamaian dunia, Arpo telah diperlengkapi kembali untuk pengasuhan, diberi kode ulang untuk dipeluk, dan secara resmi dipindahkan sebagai robot pengasuh!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Serial ini menggambarkan bagaimana karakter-karakter ini selamat dari bahaya kehidupan sehari-hari, secara tidak sengaja mengubah situasi biasa menjadi peristiwa yang tidak terduga, luar biasa, dan selalu lucu.

programme.title: Tayo Thematic Show Season 2
programme.desc: Kisah Tayo dan teman-temannya dengan berbagai tema! Kami mengundang Anda ke desa keliling tempat bus-bus kecil berkumpul.

programme.title: Pororo'S Healthy Habits
programme.desc: Halo teman-teman? Saya Pororo! Bisakah kita belajar bersama tentang bagaimana tumbuh sebagai anak yang sehat?

programme.title: Oddbods Season 2
programme.desc: Geng Fuse, Newt, Pogo, Bubbles, Jeff, Zee, dan Slick yang unik dan unik tertawa, menipu, dan menjalani hidup mereka.

programme.title: Kesetiaan
programme.desc: Nadya (ANGGIKA BOLSTERLI), seorang dosen sukses, telah menikah dengan Pram (OMAR DANIEL). Setelah Pram kehilangan pekerjaan dan berkali-kali gagal membangun bisnis karena insiden kecelakaan di masa lalu, Nadya menjadi tulang punggung keluarga. Merasa rendah diri, Pram berubah menjadi suami toxic yang suka merendahkan, mengontrol, dan selalu cemburu dengan istrinya, apalagi ada Aris (RIONALDO STOCKHORST) mantan pacar Nadya yang juga menjadi dosen di kampus, semakin membuat Pram menjadi insecure sebagai suami Nadya. Namun semua berubah ketika Nadya membawa Citra (KEYSHA ANGELICA), mahasiswinya yang sedang mengalami kesulitan hidup untuk tinggal di kostan milik Pram dan Nadya. Pram yang merasa minder dengan istrinya ternyata menemukan kenyamanan yang ia dambakan ketika bersama Citra??? Saksikan keseruan ceritanya dalam SINETRON TERBARU KESETIAAN

programme.desc: Compostman et Moi is a documentary that explores the growing movement toward sustainable living through the work of Florian Bonnet, better known as Compostman. Passionate about reducing food waste and improving urban ecology, he travels across communities to encourage composting as an accessible solution for transforming organic waste into valuable natural resources. Along the way, the film highlights environmental challenges, community initiatives, and the positive impact that individual actions can have on building a more sustainable future.

programme.desc: A lonely doctor (Sandra Bullock) and a frustrated architect (Keanu Reeves) begin exchanging letters, then discover that they are living two years apart. Starring Keanu Reeves, Sandra Bullock, Shohreh Aghdashloo.

programme.title: The Imitation Game
programme.desc: Genius British logician and cryptologist Alan Turing (Benedict Cumberbatch) helps crack Germany's Enigma Code during World War II but is later prosecuted by his government for illegal homosexual acts. Starring Benedict Cumberbatch, Keira Knightley, Matthew Goode.

programme.title: V for Vendetta

programme.title: The Other Boleyn Girl
programme.desc: Family ambition pits British sisters Anne (Natalie Portman) and Mary (Scarlett Johansson) Boleyn against each other for the affections of King Henry VIII. Starring Natalie Portman, Scarlett Johansson, Eric Bana.

programme.title: Outlander: Blood of my Blood

programme.title: Fire
programme.desc: Unhappy in their marriages, two New Delhi wives (Shabana Azmi, Nandita Das) find solace and love in each other's arms. Starring Shabana Azmi, Nandita Das, Kulbhushan Kharbanda.

programme.title: One Day in the Life of Noah Piugattuk
programme.desc: A government agent tries to get an Inuit man and his children to move to settlement housing. Starring Kim Bodnia, Apayata Kotierk, Benjamin Kunuk.

programme.title: Manufactured Landscapes
programme.desc: The work of photographer Edward Burtynsky includes China's ongoing Industrial Revolution.

programme.title: How the West Was Fun
programme.desc: Twin girls (Mary-Kate Olsen, Ashley Olsen) hatch a plan to save an old woman's dude ranch from shady developers. Starring Mary-Kate Olsen, Ashley Olsen, Martin Mull.

programme.title: Stuart Little
programme.desc: Adopted by the Littles (Geena Davis, Hugh Laurie, Jonathan Lipnicki), a mouse has various adventures which make him appreciate love and family. Starring Geena Davis, Hugh Laurie, Jonathan Lipnicki.

programme.title: The Master of Disguise
programme.desc: A genial waiter (Dana Carvey) tries to rescue his parents from a criminal mastermind by assuming various identities. Starring Dana Carvey, Jennifer Esposito, Harold Gould.

programme.title: Grown Ups
programme.desc: Friends and former teammates (Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock) learn that age does not, necessarily, equal maturity when they reunite to honor the memory of their basketball coach. Starring Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock.

programme.title: Grown Ups 2
programme.desc: Lenny Feder moves his family back to his hometown to be with his old friends and finds out that he didn't leave the crazy life behind in Los Angeles. Starring Adam Sandler, Kevin James, Chris Rock.

programme.title: The War With Grandpa
programme.desc: Forced to give up his room to his grandfather, a scheming boy devises a series of outrageous pranks in an attempt to make him move out. Starring Robert De Niro, Uma Thurman, Rob Riggle.

programme.title: My Big Fat Greek Wedding
programme.desc: Family tensions arise after a woman (Nia Vardalos) falls in love with a man (John Corbett) who is not Greek. Starring Nia Vardalos, John Corbett, Michael Constantine.

programme.title: Mrs. Doubtfire
programme.desc: An unemployed actor disguises himself as an elderly nanny in order to spend more time with his estranged family. Starring Robin Williams, Sally Field, Pierce Brosnan.

programme.title: Shrek the Halls
programme.desc: The ogre's plans for a cozy family Christmas go awry when Donkey, Puss in Boots and the rest of the fairy-tale gang try to join in the fun.

programme.title: Inside Man
programme.desc: A tough detective matches wits with a bank robber, while an enigmatic woman has her own agenda. Starring Denzel Washington, Clive Owen, Jodie Foster.

programme.title: The Taking of Pelham 123
programme.desc: A subway dispatcher (Denzel Washington) calls on his extensive knowledge of the transit system to outwit hijackers who are threatening to kill passengers unless a ransom is paid. Starring Denzel Washington, John Travolta, John Turturro.

programme.title: The Sweet Hereafter
programme.desc: A lawyer (Ian Holm) seeks input from parents who lost children in a Canadian bus crash that claimed 14 lives. Starring Ian Holm, Sarah Polley, Bruce Greenwood.

programme.title: Brooklyn
programme.desc: An Irish immigrant (Saoirse Ronan) in the 1950s New York falls for a tough Italian plumber (Emory Cohen), but faces temptation from another man (Domhnall Gleeson) when she returns to her homeland for a visit. Starring Saoirse Ronan, Domhnall Gleeson, Emory Cohen.

programme.title: Animal Behaviour
programme.desc: Various animals attend a therapy session. Starring Leah Juel, Andrea Libman, Toby Berner.

programme.title: Paco
programme.desc: Paco is a Filipino immigrant living in Canada, trying to make ends meet so he can make a better life for his family in Manila. Starring Edward Escobal, Jason Asuncion, Khia Arkysha Donguines.

programme.title: The Year Dolly Parton Was My Mom
programme.desc: Elizabeth is an average 11-year-old until she finds out her entire life is a lie. Starring Gil Bellows, Macha Grenon, Trevor Hayes.

programme.title: The Sisterhood of the Traveling Pants
programme.desc: Four teenage friends (Amber Tamblyn, Alexis Bledel, America Ferrera) keep in touch during their summer apart by passing along a cherished pair of blue jeans. Starring Amber Tamblyn, Alexis Bledel, America Ferrera.

programme.title: Free Willy
programme.desc: An abandoned boy (Jason James Richter) with a chip on his shoulder befriends an ill-fated killer whale at a water park. Starring Jason James Richter, Lori Petty, Jayne Atkinson.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever. Starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Liam Hemsworth.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Catching Fire
programme.desc: After their unprecedented victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss Everdeen and Peeta Mellark embark on a Victors Tour. Katniss senses rebellion is stirring, but a cruel change in the upcoming 75th Hunger Games may change Panem forever. Starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Liam Hemsworth.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 1
programme.desc: After shattering the games forever, Katniss (Jennifer Lawrence) finds herself in District 13, fighting to save Peeta (Josh Hutcherson) and a nation moved by her courage. Starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Liam Hemsworth.

programme.title: The Hunger Games: Mockingjay, Part 2
programme.desc: Katniss faces mortal traps, deadly enemies and moral choices when she and her closest friends leave District 13 to assassinate President Snow and liberate the citizens of war-torn Panem. Starring Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson, Liam Hemsworth.

programme.title: Mad Max: Fury Road
programme.desc: Fortified in a massive, armored truck, loner Mad Max joins Imperator Furiosa and her band of rebels as they try to outrun a warlord and his henchmen in a deadly high-speed chase through the wasteland. Starring Tom Hardy, Charlize Theron, Nicholas Hoult.

programme.title: Snowpiercer
programme.desc: A post-apocalyptic ice age forces humanity's last survivors aboard a globe-spanning supertrain. One man will risk everything to lead a revolt for control of the engine and the future of the world. Starring Chris Evans, Song Kang-ho, Tilda Swinton.

programme.title: Primrose Path
programme.desc: A shantytown tomboy's (Ginger Rogers) straight-arrow sweetheart (Joel McCrea) discovers how her mother (Marjorie Rambeau) makes a living. Starring Ginger Rogers, Joel McCrea, Marjorie Rambeau.

programme.title: The Movie Man
programme.desc: Amid a global pandemic, an entrepreneur looks back on his life's work owning and operating an idiosyncratic cinema in the forest of northern Ontario.

programme.title: Cinema Paradiso
programme.desc: A Sicilian boy (Salvatore Cascio) discovers the movies with his local theater's projectionist (Philippe Noiret). Starring Salvatore Cascio, Philippe Noiret, Marco Leonardi.

programme.title: The Purple Rose of Cairo
programme.desc: A 1930s movie star (Jeff Daniels) steps off the screen to join a waitress (Mia Farrow) in the audience. Starring Mia Farrow, Jeff Daniels, Danny Aiello.

programme.title: Sherlock, Jr.
programme.desc: After a day of playing amateur sleuth, a movie projectionist "projects" himself into a film to solve a case. Starring Buster Keaton, Kathryn McGuire, Ward Crane.

programme.title: A Little Romance
programme.desc: A worldly Parisian (Laurence Olivier) tells two teenage lovers (Diane Lane, Thelonious Bernard) to kiss at dusk under the Bridge of Sighs in Venice. Starring Laurence Olivier, Diane Lane, Thelonious Bernard.

programme.title: Last Summer
programme.desc: An independent teenager (Barbara Hershey) uses her sexuality to encourage two friends (Richard Thomas, Bruce Davison) to rape a girl whom they all ridicule. Starring Barbara Hershey, Richard Thomas, Bruce Davison.

programme.title: The Master of Ballantrae
programme.desc: Two Scottish brothers engage in fierce sibling rivalry while battling pirates, Indians and British soldiers. Starring Errol Flynn, Roger Livesey, Anthony Steel.

programme.title: The Prisoner of Zenda
programme.desc: Court followers foil a royal plot by having a look-alike English tourist (Stewart Granger) pose as the king of Ruritania. Starring Stewart Granger, Deborah Kerr, James Mason.

programme.title: The Lost City
programme.desc: An evil scientist plots to take over the world after he invents a machine that causes earthquakes.

programme.title: Dark Delusion
programme.desc: Dr. Gillespie's (Lionel Barrymore) young colleague (James Craig) treats an heiress (Lucille Bremer) for insanity against her family's wishes. Starring Lionel Barrymore, James Craig, Lucille Bremer.

programme.title: The Three Little Pups
programme.desc: A lazy wolf targets Droopy and friends. Starring Daws Butler, Bill Thompson.

programme.title: Interrupted Melody
programme.desc: Australian soprano Marjorie Lawrence (Eleanor Parker) makes a comeback after being disabled by polio. Starring Eleanor Parker, Glenn Ford, Roger Moore.

programme.title: White Heat
programme.desc: A brave federal agent poses as a thug to infiltrate psychopathic hoodlum Cody Jarrett's gang of thieves. Starring James Cagney, Virginia Mayo, Edmond O'Brien.

programme.title: San Antonio
programme.desc: A Texas cattleman (Errol Flynn) flirts with a saloon singer (Alexis Smith) and shoots it out with rustlers at the Alamo. Starring Errol Flynn, Alexis Smith, S.Z. Sakall.

programme.title: Take the High Ground
programme.desc: Two Army sergeants (Richard Widmark, Karl Malden) use different methods to produce soldiers at Fort Bliss, Texas. Starring Richard Widmark, Karl Malden, Elaine Stewart.

programme.title: American Pop
programme.desc: Young immigrant Zalmie arrives in New York City and becomes addicted to show business. When an accident ruins his voice, he marries a stripper and their son, Benny, becomes a jazz pianist. Starring Ron Thompson, Mews Small, Jerry Holland.

programme.title: Fame
programme.desc: Leroy, Coco (Irene Cara), Bruno (Lee Curreri) and others of mixed talents and means attend New York's High School of Performing Arts. Starring Irene Cara, Eddie Barth, Lee Curreri.

programme.title: Nora Prentiss
programme.desc: A nightclub singer (Ann Sheridan) inspires a doctor (Kent Smith) to fake his own murder, for which he stands trial. Starring Ann Sheridan, Kent Smith, Bruce Bennett.

programme.title: Jack L. Warner: The Last Mogul
programme.desc: Rising from humble beginnings, Jack L. Warner and his brothers make movie history by founding Warner Bros. Studios.

programme.title: To Have and Have Not
programme.desc: A boat skipper (Humphrey Bogart) flirts with a singer (Lauren Bacall) and fools Nazis on the island of Martinique. Starring Humphrey Bogart, Lauren Bacall, Walter Brennan.

programme.title: Ladies They Talk About
programme.desc: A district attorney feels a strong attraction for an imprisoned gun moll who rises to the top of the prison ladder. Starring Barbara Stanwyck, Preston Foster, Lyle Talbot.

programme.title: Lady Gangster
programme.desc: A radio-station owner (Frank Wilcox) tries to reform a small-town girl (Faye Emerson) who has fallen in with mobsters. Starring Faye Emerson, Julie Bishop, Frank Wilcox.

programme.title: Lady Scarface
programme.desc: A police detective (Dennis O'Keefe) and his photographer girlfriend (Frances Neal) hunt a gang led by a woman (Judith Anderson). Starring Dennis O'Keefe, Judith Anderson, Frances Neal.

programme.title: Nora Prentiss
programme.desc: A nightclub singer (Ann Sheridan) inspires a doctor (Kent Smith) to fake his own murder, for which he stands trial. Starring Ann Sheridan, Kent Smith, Bruce Bennett.

programme.title: The Secret Garden
programme.desc: An English orphan (Margaret O'Brien) finds the key to her bitter uncle's (Herbert Marshall) magic garden, seen in color. Starring Margaret O'Brien, Herbert Marshall, Dean Stockwell.

programme.title: The Great Sinner
programme.desc: A lucky writer (Gregory Peck) tries to get his girlfriend (Ava Gardner) and her gambler father out of debt to a casino owner (Melvyn Douglas). Starring Gregory Peck, Ava Gardner, Melvyn Douglas.

programme.title: Marriage on the Rocks
programme.desc: An adman's (Frank Sinatra) wife (Deborah Kerr) winds up wed to his buddy (Dean Martin) after a quickie Mexican divorce and marriage. Starring Frank Sinatra, Deborah Kerr, Dean Martin.

programme.title: Boys' Night Out
programme.desc: Would-be swingers Fred (James Garner), George (Tony Randall), Doug and Howard share a sexy blonde (Kim Novak) who's secretly doing a thesis on men. Starring Kim Novak, James Garner, Tony Randall.

programme.title: Incendiary Blonde
programme.desc: Texas Guinan (Betty Hutton) goes from Broadway to Hollywood to nightclub hostess in Roaring '20s New York. Starring Betty Hutton, Arturo de Cordova, Charlie Ruggles.

programme.title: The Miracle of Morgan's Creek
programme.desc: A bank clerk (Eddie Bracken) gets in trouble after posing as the unknown GI father of his girlfriend's (Betty Hutton) sextuplets. Starring Eddie Bracken, Betty Hutton, William Demarest.

programme.title: The Enchanted Cottage
